{"headword":"cashier","explanation":"「cashier」在學測中常出現在描述日常生活、購物情境或職場環境的閱讀測驗中。它是一個具體職業名稱，重點在於理解其在零售環境中的功能，以及與之相關的交易動作（如結帳、處理付款）。","senses":[{"sense":"收銀員","explanation":"在商店、餐廳或銀行中負責處理金錢交易的人員。","entries":[{"pattern":"cashier","pos":"noun","translation":"收銀員","explanation":"指在結帳櫃檯工作，負責掃描商品並收取款項的人員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After picking out several fresh vegetables and fruit, the woman walked to the <target>cashier</target> to pay for her groceries with a credit card.","translation":"在挑選了幾樣新鮮蔬菜和水果後，那位女士走向收銀員，用信用卡支付她的雜貨費用。"},{"sentence":"The young student worked as a part-time <target>cashier</target> at the local supermarket to save enough money for his first university textbook.","translation":"這名年輕學生在當地超市擔任兼職收銀員，為了存夠錢買他的第一本大學教科書。"},{"sentence":"Because the store was having a huge holiday sale, the line of customers waiting for the <target>cashier</target> was incredibly long.","translation":"因為商店正在進行巨大的節日促銷，等待收銀員結帳的顧客隊伍異常地長。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"clerk","pos":"noun","translation":"店員；文員","explanation":"較泛指在商店或辦公室工作的基層員工"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 cash (現金) 加上職業字尾 -ier","related":[{"word":"cash","pos":"noun","translation":"現金","explanation":"指可用於交易的實體錢幣或紙鈔。"},{"word":"cash","pos":"verb","translation":"兌現","explanation":"將支票或禮券轉換為現金。"}]}}

{"headword":"cavity","explanation":"「cavity」在學測中常見於兩個極端不同的語境：一是牙科醫療的「蛀牙」；二是地理或生物解剖的「孔洞/腔室」。在閱讀測驗中，學生必須根據上下文（如牙醫、牙膏、或地質構造）快速判斷其具體含義。","senses":[{"sense":"孔洞；腔室","explanation":"指任何物體內部被掏空或天然形成的空間。","entries":[{"pattern":"cavity","pos":"noun","translation":"孔洞；腔室","explanation":"指物理上的空腔，可用於描述人體器官（如胸腔）或地質構造。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small bird built its nest inside a deep <target>cavity</target> in an old tree, keeping its eggs safe from the wind.","translation":"這隻小鳥在一個古老樹木的深孔中築巢，讓它的蛋免受風雨影響。"},{"sentence":"Medical students must learn about the thoracic <target>cavity</target>, which is the space in the chest that protects the heart and lungs.","translation":"醫學生必須學習關於胸腔的知識，也就是胸腔中保護心臟與肺部的空間。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hole","pos":"noun","translation":"洞","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞彙"},{"word":"hollow","pos":"noun","translation":"空心處","explanation":"強調物體內部是空的"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"蛀牙","explanation":"由細菌腐蝕牙齒而形成的孔洞。","entries":[{"pattern":"a cavity in one's tooth","pos":"noun","translation":"牙齒上的蛀牙","explanation":"牙科情境的專用詞彙。在學測中常出現在關於健康管理或生物學文章中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the little girl loved eating sweet candies and forgot to brush her teeth, she developed a deep <target>cavity</target> in her back molar.","translation":"因為這個小女孩喜歡吃甜糖果且忘記刷牙，她在後臼齒上形成了一個深蛀牙。"},{"sentence":"The dentist told my brother that he needs to have a <target>cavity</target> <pattern>filled</pattern>, because the decay had reached the nerve of the tooth.","translation":"牙醫告訴我哥哥他需要補牙（填補蛀牙），因為腐蝕已經到達了牙齒的神經。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"decay","pos":"noun","translation":"蛀牙；腐蝕","explanation":"指牙齒腐蝕的過程或結果"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"來自拉丁語 cavus (空的)","related":[{"word":"concave","pos":"adjective","translation":"凹的","explanation":"字首 con- (一起) + cav (空)，指像空腔一樣向內凹陷的形狀。"},{"word":"convex","pos":"adjective","translation":"凸的","explanation":"與 concave 相對，指向外凸出的形狀。"}]}}

{"headword":"census","explanation":"「census」在學測中常出現在社會科學、人口統計或政府政策類型的文章中。它不僅指一次「人口普查」的行為，也常指普查後所產生的「統計數據」，學生應注意其在句中是作為過程還是結果。","senses":[{"sense":"人口普查；統計數據","explanation":"由政府主導，對全國或特定區域內所有居民進行的正式人口統計。","entries":[{"pattern":"conduct a census","pos":"noun","translation":"進行人口普查","explanation":"動詞 conduct (進行) 是 census 的高頻搭配，用來描述政府啟動普查程序的正式過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Every ten years, the national government decides to <pattern>conduct</pattern> a full <target>census</target> to determine the total population of the country.","translation":"每隔十年，國家政府會決定進行一次全面的人口普查，以確定該國的總人口數。"},{"sentence":"The local council is planning to <pattern>conduct</pattern> a <target>census</target> of the homeless people living in the city center to improve social services.","translation":"地方議會正計畫對居住在市中心的無家可歸者進行人口統計，以改善社會服務。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"census data / records","pos":"noun","translation":"普查數據／紀錄","explanation":"此處 census 作為名詞修飾語，指普查後收集到的具體資訊，常用於分析社會趨勢或政策制定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"By analyzing the latest <target>census</target> <pattern>data</pattern>, researchers discovered that more young adults are moving from the countryside to big cities.","translation":"透過分析最新的普查數據，研究人員發現更多年輕成年人正從鄉村搬遷到大城市。"},{"sentence":"The historians used official <target>census</target> <pattern>records</pattern> from the 19th century to understand how the Industrial Revolution affected family sizes.","translation":"歷史學家利用 19 世紀的官方普查紀錄，來了解工業革命如何影響家庭規模。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"survey","pos":"noun","translation":"調查；普查","explanation":"較泛指各種形式的問卷或抽樣調查，不一定像 census 那樣全面"},{"word":"poll","pos":"noun","translation":"民意調查","explanation":"通常指針對特定議題或選舉傾向的快速抽樣調查"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自拉丁語 censere (評估、計算)","related":[{"word":"censused","pos":"adjective","translation":"經過普查的","explanation":"較少見，指已被納入統計範圍的。"},{"word":"census-taker","pos":"noun","translation":"普查員","explanation":"負責挨家挨戶收集普查資訊的人員。"}]}}

{"headword":"comrade","explanation":"「comrade」是一個帶有強烈情感色彩的詞彙，通常指在共同經歷過艱難環境或共同追求同一政治目標的人。在現代英語中，它除了指「戰友」或「同僚」，在歷史背景中常與社會主義或共產主義的稱呼相關聯。","senses":[{"sense":"同志；戰友；同僚","explanation":"指在軍隊、政治運動或艱苦環境中共同奮鬥、具有深厚情誼的人。","entries":[{"pattern":"comrade","pos":"noun","translation":"同志；戰友","explanation":"指共同經歷戰火或艱辛的人，強調一種基於共同命運的深厚連結。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the long years of the war, the soldier felt a deep bond with his <target>comrades</target> who had fought beside him in the trenches.","translation":"在漫長的戰爭歲月中，這名士兵與那些在戰壕中與他並肩作戰的戰友們之間感受到一種深厚的連結。"},{"sentence":"The old veteran spent his weekends visiting the graves of his fallen <target>comrades</target> to remember the bravery they showed during the battle.","translation":"這位老退伍軍人利用週末去探訪他那些陣亡戰友的墳墓，以紀念他們在戰鬥中展現的勇氣。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"a comrade-in-arms","pos":"noun","translation":"出生入死之戰友","explanation":"固定片語，用來特指在軍事衝突中共同作戰的人，語氣比單純的 comrade 更強烈。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The two generals remained close friends for their entire lives because they had been <target>comrades</target>-<pattern>in-arms</pattern> during the revolution.","translation":"這兩位將領終其一生都保持著親密關係，因為他們在革命期間曾是出生入死之戰友。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"companion","pos":"noun","translation":"同伴；伴侶","explanation":"泛指一起活動或生活的人，不一定有共同目標"},{"word":"ally","pos":"noun","translation":"盟友","explanation":"指在政治或戰爭中為了共同利益而合作的人"},{"word":"colleague","pos":"noun","translation":"同事；同僚","explanation":"指在同一工作場所工作的專業人士"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"enemy","pos":"noun","translation":"敵人","explanation":null},{"word":"adversary","pos":"noun","translation":"對手；敵手","explanation":"強調競爭或對抗關係"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 com- (共同) 與字根 rade (夥伴/同僚)","related":[{"word":"company","pos":"noun","translation":"公司；陪伴","explanation":"源自同根詞，指在一起的人或組織。"},{"word":"companion","pos":"noun","translation":"同伴","explanation":"由 com- (共同) + pan (麵包，意指一起吃飯的人) 演變而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"coral","explanation":"「coral」在學測中主要出現在自然環境、海洋生態保護或生物多樣性等主題的閱讀測驗中。它既可作為名詞指稱海洋中的珊瑚礁，也可作為形容詞描述顏色或材質，學習者應注意其在句中扮演的角色。","senses":[{"sense":"珊瑚；珊瑚礁","explanation":"指由珊瑚蟲分泌的碳酸鈣骨骼所構成的海洋生物及其形成的礁石。","entries":[{"pattern":"coral reef","pos":"noun","translation":"珊瑚礁","explanation":"最高頻的搭配詞，通常用於描述海洋生態系統、氣候變遷導致的珊瑚白化等環境議題。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest <pattern>coral reef</pattern>, providing a safe home for thousands of different species of fish.","translation":"大堡礁是世界上最大的珊瑚礁，為數千種不同的魚類提供了安全的家園。"},{"sentence":"Rising ocean temperatures are causing widespread <target>coral</target> <pattern>reefs</pattern> to turn white and die, which harms the entire marine ecosystem.","translation":"上升的海洋溫度導致大範圍的珊瑚礁變白並死亡，這對整個海洋生態系統造成了傷害。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"reef","pos":"noun","translation":"礁石","explanation":"指水下或水面附近的岩石結構"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"珊瑚色的；珊瑚材質的","explanation":"描述一種介於紅色與橙色之間的亮色，或是由珊瑚製成的物品。","entries":[{"pattern":"coral (color)","pos":"adjective","translation":"珊瑚色的","explanation":"用於描述色彩，常修飾衣服、妝容或自然景觀。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The bride chose a beautiful <target>coral</target> dress for her beach wedding, which matched the sunset colors of the ocean perfectly.","translation":"新娘為她的海灘婚禮選擇了一件漂亮的珊瑚色禮服，這與海洋的日落色彩完美契合。"}],"tier":"secondary"},{"pattern":"coral jewelry","pos":"adjective","translation":"珊瑚材質的珠寶","explanation":"指由天然珊瑚雕刻或製成而成的飾品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the museum, we saw several pieces of ancient <target>coral</target> <pattern>jewelry</pattern> that were crafted by skilled artists centuries ago.","translation":"在博物館中，我們看到了幾件由熟練藝術家在數世紀前製作的古老珊瑚珠寶。"}],"tier":"tertiary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"coralline","pos":"adjective","translation":"珊瑚的；珊瑚狀的","explanation":"較為專業的生物學術語，指與珊瑚相關的性質。"}]}}

{"headword":"corpse","explanation":"「corpse」專指人類的屍體，與動物屍體常用的 carcass 不同。在閱讀測驗中，此字常出現在偵探小說、法醫分析或歷史考古的描述中，強調的是失去生命後的物理狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"屍體","explanation":"指人類死亡後遺留的身體實體。","entries":[{"pattern":"corpse","pos":"noun","translation":"屍體","explanation":"可數名詞，指死後的身體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police officers carefully examined the <target>corpse</target> found in the abandoned warehouse to search for any clues about the cause of death.","translation":"警察小心地檢查在廢棄倉庫中發現的屍體，以尋找關於死因的任何線索。"},{"sentence":"In many ancient cultures, people believed that the <target>corpse</target> must be preserved through special rituals to ensure the soul could travel to the next world.","translation":"在許多古代文化中，人們相信屍體必須透過特殊的儀式來保存，以確保靈魂能夠前往另一個世界。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"body","pos":"noun","translation":"身體；屍體","explanation":"最通用且中性的詞彙，可用於活人或死者"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"corporate","pos":"adjective","translation":"公司的；法人的","explanation":"雖然語源相關，但現代英語中語意已完全分開，指集體或公司形態。"}]}}

{"headword":"cosmetics","explanation":"「cosmetics」在學測中通常作為名詞使用，指稱化妝品或美容產品。在使用時要注意它既可以作為不可數名詞指稱整體類別，也可以作為可數名詞指稱個別產品。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在探討消費主義、個體美感或化妝工業對環境影響的議題中。","senses":[{"sense":"化妝品；美容產品","explanation":"用來改變外貌或美化皮膚的物質，如口紅、粉底或眼影等。","entries":[{"pattern":"cosmetics","pos":"noun","translation":"化妝品","explanation":"指整體的化妝品類別或多種化妝產品。常與形容詞如 natural, organic 或 expensive 搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many young women prefer to use natural <target>cosmetics</target> because they believe that organic ingredients are safer for their skin.","translation":"許多年輕女性偏好使用天然化妝品，因為她們相信有機成分對皮膚更安全。"},{"sentence":"The department store opened a new section dedicated to luxury <target>cosmetics</target>, attracting many customers who love high-end beauty brands.","translation":"百貨公司開設了一個專門銷售奢侈化妝品的區域，吸引了許多熱愛高端美容品牌的顧客。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"cosmetic surgery","pos":"noun","translation":"美容手術","explanation":"指為了美化外貌而非醫療目的而進行的手術，屬於高頻的複合名詞搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"With the rise of social media, more people are choosing to undergo <target>cosmetic</target> <pattern>surgery</pattern> to achieve a perfect look.","translation":"隨著社群媒體的興起，越來越多的人選擇接受美容手術以追求完美的長相。"},{"sentence":"The doctor warned the patient that <target>cosmetic</target> <pattern>surgery</pattern> is not a risk-free process and requires a long recovery time.","translation":"醫生警告患者，美容手術並非沒有風險的過程，且需要較長的恢復時間。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"makeup","pos":"noun","translation":"化妝品；妝容","explanation":"最常用的口語詞彙，指稱化妝品本身或臉上的妝容。"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自希臘語 kosmetikos (秩序、裝飾) 加上名詞字尾 -ics","related":[{"word":"cosmetic","pos":"adjective","translation":"美容的；表面上的","explanation":"指與美化外貌有關，或指僅在表面上做出的、不涉及核心問題的改變。"},{"word":"cosmetologist","pos":"noun","translation":"美容師","explanation":"指專業從事美容、化妝及美甲等工作的人員。"}]}}

{"headword":"counterpart","explanation":"「counterpart」在學測中常用於對比兩個相似的對象，特別是在描述不同國家、組織或職位時，用以指代「對等的人或物」。理解這個字的核心在於其「對稱性」與「相對應」的概念。","senses":[{"sense":"對等的人或物；相對應之對象","explanation":"指在不同系統、組織或環境中，具有相同地位、功能或特質的人或物。","entries":[{"pattern":"counterpart","pos":"noun","translation":"對等的人或物","explanation":"指在另一個組織或國家中處於相同職位或地位的人。常用於外交、政治或企業描述。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The Taiwanese education minister met with his Japanese <target>counterpart</target> to discuss how to improve student mental health in schools.","translation":"台灣的教育部長與其日本的對等職位者（教育部長）會面，討論如何改善學校學生的心理健康。"},{"sentence":"The new electric car is much quieter than its gas-powered <target>counterpart</target>, making it a better choice for city drivers.","translation":"這款新型電動車比其燃油對應產品安靜許多，使其成為城市駕駛者的更好選擇。"},{"sentence":"While the city center is crowded and noisy, its rural <target>counterpart</target> offers a peaceful environment and fresh air for visitors.","translation":"雖然市中心擁擠且嘈雜，但其鄉村的對應地帶則為遊客提供了一個寧靜的環境與新鮮空氣。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"equivalent","pos":"noun","translation":"等同物；等值的人","explanation":"強調在價值、功能或地位上完全相等"},{"word":"peer","pos":"noun","translation":"同儕；同級者","explanation":"強調年齡、社會地位或能力相當的人"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 counter- (相對、相反) 與字根 part (部分、角色)","related":[{"word":"counteract","pos":"verb","translation":"抵消；對抗","explanation":"字首 counter- (相反) + act (行動)，意為採取相反行動以抵消影響。"},{"word":"counterattack","pos":"verb","translation":"反擊","explanation":"字首 counter- (相反) + attack (攻擊)，意為在被攻擊後立即回擊。"},{"word":"counterintuitive","pos":"adjective","translation":"違反直覺的","explanation":"字首 counter- (相反) + intuitive (直覺的)，意為不符合常理的推論。"}]}}

{"headword":"cowardly","explanation":"「cowardly」在學測中常被誤認為副詞，因為它以 -ly 結尾。然而，它是一個形容詞，用來描述一個人的性格或行為表現出缺乏勇氣。在閱讀測驗中，常出現於討論道德勇氣、英雄主義或人際衝突的文本中。","senses":[{"sense":"膽小的；懦弱的","explanation":"指缺乏勇氣去面對困難、危險或疼痛，尤其是當他人需要幫助或面對正義時。","entries":[{"pattern":"cowardly behavior","pos":"adjective","translation":"膽小的行為","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，描述某種行動缺乏勇氣，通常帶有強烈的負面評價。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young soldier was criticized for his <target>cowardly</target> <pattern>behavior</pattern> during the battle, as he ran away while his friends stayed to fight.","translation":"那名年輕士兵在戰鬥中的膽小行為受到了批評，因為他在朋友們留下來戰鬥時選擇逃跑。"},{"sentence":"Leaving the victim alone in the rain without calling for help was a <target>cowardly</target> <pattern>act</pattern> that no one could respect.","translation":"在雨中將受害者單獨留下且不撥打求救電話，是一種沒有人會尊重的懦弱行為。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"a cowardly person","pos":"adjective","translation":"一個膽小的人","explanation":"直接修飾人物的性格特質，強調其缺乏勇氣的本質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"He had always been a <target>cowardly</target> <pattern>person</pattern>, avoiding any risk or challenge that might force him to speak his mind.","translation":"他一直是一個膽小的人，總是避開任何可能強迫他表達心聲的風險或挑戰。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"timid","pos":"adjective","translation":"膽小的；羞怯的","explanation":"指因缺乏自信或害怕而表現得小心翼翼，語氣較中性"},{"word":"fearful","pos":"adjective","translation":"恐懼的","explanation":"強調對特定危險感到害怕"},{"word":"craven","pos":"adjective","translation":"極其懦弱的","explanation":"較正式且語氣更強烈的詞彙"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"brave","pos":"adjective","translation":"勇敢的","explanation":null},{"word":"courageous","pos":"adjective","translation":"有勇氣的","explanation":"強調面對困難或危險時展現出的道德勇氣"},{"word":"valiant","pos":"adjective","translation":"英勇的","explanation":"常用於描述在戰鬥或極端困難情況下的英勇表現"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 coward (膽小鬼) 加上形容詞字尾 -ly","related":[{"word":"coward","pos":"noun","translation":"膽小鬼","explanation":"核心名詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"cozy","explanation":"「cozy」在學測中常用於描述環境、室內空間或人際關係，強調一種「溫暖、舒適且有安全感」的感覺。它不僅是指物理上的溫度溫暖，更多的是心理上的放鬆與親密感，常用於描述居家環境或溫馨的小店。","senses":[{"sense":"溫暖舒適的；溫馨的","explanation":"指空間狹小但溫暖，或環境讓人感到放鬆且安全。","entries":[{"pattern":"cozy room / house / corner","pos":"adjective","translation":"溫馨的房間／房子／角落","explanation":"用來修飾空間，強調該處雖然可能不大，但布置得非常舒適且讓人感到溫馨。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After a long day of studying for finals, I love to curl up in a <target>cozy</target> <pattern>corner</pattern> of the library with a good book.","translation":"在準備期末考辛苦一整天後，我喜歡在圖書館一個溫馨的角落裡蜷縮著，讀一本好書。"},{"sentence":"The small cafe in the alley has a <target>cozy</target> <pattern>atmosphere</pattern> that makes every customer feel welcome and relaxed.","translation":"小巷子裡的那間咖啡廳有一種溫馨的氣氛，讓每位顧客都感到受歡迎且放鬆。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"feel cozy","pos":"adjective","translation":"感覺溫暖舒適","explanation":"作為補語，描述人對環境產生的主觀心理感受。","sentences":[{"sentence":"With the warm fireplace burning and a soft blanket over her legs, Sarah felt <target>cozy</target> and safe inside her home.","translation":"隨著壁爐燃燒著溫暖的火光，腿上蓋著柔軟的毯子，莎拉在家裡感到溫暖舒適且安全。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"comfortable","pos":"adjective","translation":"舒適的","explanation":"最通用的舒適，包含物理與心理層面"},{"word":"snug","pos":"adjective","translation":"溫暖舒適的；緊湊的","explanation":"強調空間緊湊但非常溫暖"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"uncomfortable","pos":"adjective","translation":"不舒適的","explanation":null},{"word":"cold","pos":"adjective","translation":"寒冷的","explanation":null}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"coziness","pos":"noun","translation":"舒適溫馨","explanation":"由形容詞 cozy 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"crackdown","explanation":"「crackdown」在閱讀測驗中常用於描述政府、警方或校方針對特定違法或違規行為採取「嚴厲打擊」或「強力取締」的行動。此字帶有強烈的強制力與權威感，通常搭配動詞 like take a crackdown on 或 be a crackdown on。","senses":[{"sense":"嚴厲打擊；強力取締","explanation":"採取強硬手段以停止非法或不被允許的行為。","entries":[{"pattern":"crackdown on sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"對某事的嚴厲打擊","explanation":"最常見的搭配，on 後接被取締的對象（如毒品、非法建築、違規駕駛等）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The city police announced a sudden <target>crackdown</target> <pattern>on</pattern> illegal parking in the downtown area to reduce traffic jams.","translation":"市警局宣布將對市中心地區的違規停車採取突然的強力取締，以減少交通堵塞。"},{"sentence":"After several dangerous accidents, the school principal decided to start a strict <target>crackdown</target> <pattern>on</pattern> students using mobile phones during class.","translation":"在發生幾起危險事故後，校長決定開始嚴厲打擊學生在課堂上使用手機的行為。"},{"sentence":"The government is planning a nationwide <target>crackdown</target> <pattern>on</pattern> tax evasion to ensure that all big companies pay their fair share.","translation":"政府正計劃在全國範圍內強力取締逃稅行為，以確保所有大公司都支付其應負擔的稅款。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"suppression","pos":"noun","translation":"鎮壓；抑制","explanation":"強調使用武力或權力強行停止某事"},{"word":"clampdown","pos":"noun","translation":"強力取締","explanation":"與 crackdown 近義，語氣同樣強硬"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"leniency","pos":"noun","translation":"寬大；寬容","explanation":"指處置對象時採取寬鬆、不嚴厲的態度"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 crack down (強硬對付) 的名詞化","related":[{"word":"crack","pos":"verb","translation":"擊碎；破裂","explanation":"在此詞組中 crack down 原意為像擊碎東西一樣強硬地採取行動。"},{"word":"crack","pos":"noun","translation":"裂縫","explanation":"指物理上的小裂縫，與 crackdown 無關。"}]}}

{"headword":"cracker","explanation":"「cracker」在學測中通常出現在生活化或文化相關的閱讀測驗中。最常見的含義是飲食中的「蘇打餅乾」，但也需注意其在不同情境下可能指代「破解工具」或在極少數非正式語境中的特定指稱。","senses":[{"sense":"蘇打餅乾；薄脆餅乾","explanation":"一種經過烘烤、口感酥脆且通常味道較淡的薄餅乾。","entries":[{"pattern":"cracker","pos":"noun","translation":"蘇打餅乾；薄脆餅乾","explanation":"指一種鹹味或原味的薄脆餅乾，常作為零食或搭配起司、奶油食用。","sentences":[{"sentence":"For a quick and healthy snack between classes, the student decided to eat a few <target>crackers</target> with a small slice of apple.","translation":"在課間想吃個快速且健康的點心，這名學生決定吃幾片蘇打餅乾搭配一小片蘋果。"},{"sentence":"During the long hiking trip, the explorers carried a box of salty <target>crackers</target> because they stayed fresh for a long time.","translation":"在長途徒步旅行中，探險家們攜帶了一盒鹹蘇打餅乾，因為它們能長時間保持新鮮。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"biscuit","pos":"noun","translation":"餅乾","explanation":"在英式英語中常用於指稱各類餅乾"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"credible","explanation":"「credible」在學測中常用於描述訊息、證據、來源或人的可靠性。它不僅表示「可信的」，在閱讀測驗中常與「證據 (evidence)」或「來源 (source)」搭配，用以判斷論點是否成立。","senses":[{"sense":"可信的；可靠的","explanation":"指某事物或某人足以讓人相信其真實性或正確性。","entries":[{"pattern":"credible evidence / source / witness","pos":"adjective","translation":"可信的證據／來源／證人","explanation":"最常見的搭配，指該證據或來源具有公信力，能被社會或法律認可。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that the witness provided <target>credible</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> that proved the defendant was actually at home during the crime.","translation":"律師辯稱該證人提供了可信的證據，證明被告在犯罪期間實際上是在家中。"},{"sentence":"When writing a research paper, students should only use <target>credible</target> <pattern>sources</pattern> such as academic journals instead of random blog credible","pos":"adjective","translation":"是可信的；值得信賴的","explanation":"用來描述一個人的言行或一個故事的內容在邏輯上是合理的，足以被相信。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The excuse he gave for missing the exam was {"headword":"deplete","explanation":"「deplete」在學測中常出現在環境保護、資源管理或健康議題的文章中。它強調的是資源從「充足」逐漸變為「匱乏」的動態過程，而非單純的「沒有」。","senses":[{"sense":"耗盡；使枯竭","explanation":"指資源、儲備或能量被大量使用而逐漸減少直到幾乎完盡。","entries":[{"pattern":"deplete sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"耗盡某物","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是自然資源（如森林、水源）、財務儲備（如存款）或身體能量（如體力、血紅蛋白）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If we continue to cut down too many trees, we will eventually <target>deplete</target> the natural <pattern>forests</pattern> that protect our land from floods.","translation":"如果我們繼續砍伐過多樹木，我們最終將耗盡保護我們土地免於洪水的天然森林。"},{"sentence":"The long and tiring journey through the hot desert <target>depleted</target> the travelers' <pattern>energy</pattern>, leaving them exhausted and unable to walk.","translation":"這趟穿越酷熱沙漠的漫長且疲憊的旅程耗盡了旅行者的體力，讓他們精疲力竭且無法行走。"},{"sentence":"The government warned that spending too much money on luxury projects would quickly <target>deplete</target> the national <pattern>reserve</pattern> of gold.","translation":"政府警告說，將過多金錢花在奢侈的專案上將會快速耗盡國家的黃金儲備。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"exhaust","pos":"verb","translation":"耗盡；使疲憊","explanation":"強調將所有資源或體力全部用完"},{"word":"drain","pos":"verb","translation":"排乾；耗盡","explanation":"像排水一樣將資源緩慢但持續地抽乾"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"replenish","pos":"verb","translation":"補充；填滿","explanation":"指將耗盡的資源重新填滿或恢復到原先的量"},{"word":"restore","pos":"verb","translation":"translation","explanation":"恢復；還原"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"depleted","past_participle":"depleted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 ple (填滿) 加上字首 de- (去掉、除去) 形成 deplete (使不再填滿 → 耗盡)","related":[{"word":"depletion","pos":"noun","translation":"消耗；枯竭","explanation":"由動詞 deplete 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來，常指 ozone depletion (臭氧層損耗)。"},{"word":"ample","pos":"adjective","translation":"充足的；寬敞的","explanation":"共享字根 ple/pl (填滿)，指量充足。"},{"word":"supplement","pos":"noun","translation":"補充品；增刊","explanation":"字根 supple- (填滿) 的衍生詞，意為填補空缺。"}]}}

{"headword":"detention","explanation":"「detention」在學校語境中指「留校處分」，而在法律或軍事語境中則指「拘留」或「扣押」。學生在閱讀測驗中需根據文章背景（如校園生活 vs. 法律案件）迅速判斷其具體含義。","senses":[{"sense":"留校處分","explanation":"指學生因違反校規而被要求在課後或週末留在學校接受處罰。","entries":[{"pattern":"be in detention","pos":"noun","translation":"被留校處分","explanation":"描述學生目前處於被處罰留校的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because he kept chatting during the final exam, the student <pattern>was</pattern> <target>in detention</target> until five o'clock yesterday afternoon.","translation":"因為他在期末考期間不斷聊天，那名學生昨天下午被留校處分直到五點。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"give sb. detention","pos":"noun","translation":"給某人留校處分","explanation":"由老師或校方執行處罰的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The strict history teacher <target>gave</target> the entire class <pattern>detention</pattern> because no one had completed the reading assignment on time.","translation":"那位嚴厲的歷史老師給了全班留校處分，因為沒有人準時完成閱讀作業。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"拘留；扣押","explanation":"指由官方機構（如警察或軍方）強制限制某人的行動自由。","entries":[{"pattern":"detention","pos":"noun","translation":"拘留；扣押","explanation":"指法律上的限制自由狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The human rights group expressed deep concern over the prolonged <target>detention</target> of political prisoners without a fair trial.","translation":"該人權組織對政治犯在沒有公正審判的情況下被長期拘留表示深切關注。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"custody","pos":"noun","translation":"拘留；監護","explanation":"常用於 police custody 指警方拘留"},{"word":"confinement","pos":"noun","translation":"禁閉；限制","explanation":"強調被限制在狹小空間內"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"release","pos":"noun","translation":"釋放","explanation":null},{"word":"liberation","pos":"noun","translation":"解放","explanation":null}],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 detain (拘留/延遲) + 名詞字尾 -ion","related":[{"word":"detain","pos":"verb","translation":"拘留；耽擱","explanation":"核心動詞，指強行留住某人或使其延遲。"}]}}

{"headword":"diabetes","explanation":"「diabetes」是一個不可數名詞，指糖尿病。在學測中，此類醫學術語常出現在健康、生物或營養學相關的閱讀文章中，重點在於理解其對身體機能（如血糖控制）的影響以及預防方式。","senses":[{"sense":"糖尿病","explanation":"一種因胰島素分泌不足或身體對胰島素反應不佳，導致血液中葡萄糖濃度過高而引起的代謝疾病。","entries":[{"pattern":"diabetes","pos":"noun","translation":"糖尿病","explanation":"作為疾病名稱，通常不加冠詞使用，直接描述疾病狀態或其影響。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Eating too many sugary drinks and snacks can increase the risk of developing <target>diabetes</target> in young children.","translation":"攝取過多含糖飲料和零食會增加年幼兒童罹患糖尿病的風險。"},{"sentence":"Doctors recommend a balanced diet and regular exercise to help patients with <target>diabetes</target> maintain a healthy blood sugar level.","translation":"醫生建議糖尿病患者採取均衡飲食並規律運動，以幫助他們維持健康的血糖水平。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"diabetic","pos":"adjective","translation":"糖尿病的","explanation":"形容詞形式，用來描述與糖尿病相關的症狀或飲食。"},{"word":"diabetic","pos":"noun","translation":"糖尿病患者","explanation":"指患有糖尿病的人。"}]}}

{"headword":"exempt","explanation":"「exempt」在學測中常用於討論法律、稅務、規則或義務的豁免。其核心概念是「被允許不去做某事」或「不受某項限制」。學生應特別注意其後方常接介系詞 from，形成 exempt from sth. 的固定搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"豁免的；不受限制的","explanation":"指因為特定條件或身份而不需要遵守一般的法律、規則或履行義務。","entries":[{"pattern":"exempt from sth.","pos":"adjective","translation":"免除…；不受…限制","explanation":"最核心的用法。後接義務、稅金或規則，表示主詞不需要履行該項要求。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she has a high level of academic achievement, the school decided to <target>exempt</target> her <pattern>from</pattern> the basic English course.","translation":"因為她有極高的學術成就，學校決定免除她修習基礎英文課程的義務。"},{"sentence":"Low-income families are often <target>exempt</target> <pattern>from</pattern> paying city taxes to help them manage their daily living costs more easily.","translation":"低收入家庭通常被豁免繳納城市稅金，以幫助他們更容易地管理日常生活開支。"},{"sentence":"Professional athletes are not <target>exempt</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the rules of the game, and they must follow every instruction from the referee.","translation":"職業運動員並非不受比賽規則限制，他們必須遵守裁判的每一項指示。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"immune","pos":"adjective","translation":"免疫的；免除的","explanation":"強調不受某種負面影響或懲罰的影響"},{"word":"excused","pos":"adjective","translation":"被允許不做的","explanation":"較非正式，指因正當理由而獲准不參加"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"liable","pos":"adjective","translation":"有義務的；有責任的","explanation":"指法律上或義務上必須承擔某事"},{"word":"subject to","pos":"adjective","translation":"易受…影響的；須服從於…","explanation":"指必須遵守某項規則或法律"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 empt (拿走、取走)，意為將某項義務從某人身上拿走。","related":[{"word":"emption","pos":"noun","translation":"購買；取得","explanation":"法律術語，指取得某種權利。"},{"word":"redemption","pos":"noun","translation":"贖回；救贖","explanation":"字首 re- (回) + empt (拿走/買回)，意為把失去的東西買回來。"}]}}

{"headword":"eyesight","explanation":"「eyesight」指的是視覺能力或視力。在學測中，常出現於健康議題、年齡增長導致的生理機能下降或生物演化（如動物的視力特徵）等討論中。需注意它與 vision 的近義關係，但 eyesight 較常指生理上的「看見的能力」。","senses":[{"sense":"視力；視覺能力","explanation":"指眼睛接收光線並形成影像的能力，通常與清晰度或品質相關。","entries":[{"pattern":"eyesight","pos":"noun","translation":"視力","explanation":"作為不可數名詞，描述一個人看東西的清晰程度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After spending too many hours staring at a computer screen every day, the student noticed that his <target>eyesight</target> was gradually becoming worse.","translation":"每天盯著電腦螢幕太長時間後，這名學生注意到他的視力正逐漸惡化。"},{"sentence":"The old man can no longer read the small letters in the newspaper because his <target>eyesight</target> has failed him in his old age.","translation":"那位老人再也無法閱讀報紙上的小字，因為他的視力隨著年齡增長而衰退了。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"out of eyesight","pos":"noun","translation":"在視線之外","explanation":"指某物或某人已離開了能被看見的範圍。等同於 out of sight。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small boat sailed slowly away from the shore until it finally disappeared and was completely <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>eyesight</target>.","translation":"那艘小船緩緩地駛離岸邊，直到它最終消失，完全處在視線之外。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"vision","pos":"noun","translation":"視力；視覺","explanation":"最接近的同義詞，但 vision 也可以指對未來的想像或願景。"},{"word":"sight","pos":"noun","translation":"視力；視覺","explanation":"泛指看見的能力或看到的景象。"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 eye (眼睛) + sight (視覺/視線)","related":[{"word":"sight","pos":"noun","translation":"視力；景象","explanation":"核心根源名詞。"},{"word":"sightseeing","pos":"noun","translation":"觀光","explanation":"由 sight (景觀) + seeing (看) 組成，指參觀名勝古蹟。"},{"word":"insight","pos":"noun","translation":"洞察力；深刻見解","explanation":"字首 in- (向內) + sight (看)，意為看穿事物內在的本質。"}]}}

{"headword":"faction","explanation":"「faction」在閱讀測驗中常出現於探討政治衝突、歷史變遷或組織內部權力鬥爭的文本。它與一般的 group 或 party 不同，強調的是「對立」與「內部衝突」的負面色彩。","senses":[{"sense":"小派系；分幫結派","explanation":"指一個較大組織或政黨內部，因觀點、利益或目標不一致而分裂出的較小群體。","entries":[{"pattern":"faction","pos":"noun","translation":"派系；小集團","explanation":"指組織內部產生分歧後形成的對立群體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The political party was divided into two competing <target>factions</target>, each fighting for control over the government's new budget plan.","translation":"這個政黨被分成了兩個競爭的派系，各自為了爭奪政府新預算計畫的控制權而鬥爭。"},{"sentence":"Within the local school board, a small <target>faction</target> of teachers strongly disagreed with the new rules about using tablets in class.","translation":"在當地的學校委員會中，一小群老師組成的派系強烈反對在課堂上使用平板電腦的新規定。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sect","pos":"noun","translation":"宗派；小教派","explanation":"通常指宗教上的分派"},{"word":"clique","pos":"noun","translation":"小圈子；排外的小團體","explanation":"強調社交上的排他性"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自拉丁語 factio (組成、形成)","related":[{"word":"factional","pos":"adjective","translation":"派系的；宗派的","explanation":"用來描述與派系鬥爭相關的性質。"},{"word":"factionalism","pos":"noun","translation":"派系主義","explanation":"指內部集體分裂並產生衝突的現象。"}]}}

{"headword":"falter","explanation":"「falter」在學測中常用於描述一個人的信心、聲音或計畫在面臨壓力時出現的動搖或不穩定。這個字強調的是「原本順暢但突然變得遲疑」的過程，常用於文學性較強的閱讀測驗或描述人物心路歷程的文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"動搖；遲疑","explanation":"指在信心、決心或語調上失去穩定，表現出不確定或恐懼。","entries":[{"pattern":"falter in sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"在…方面動搖","explanation":"後接信心、勇氣或決心等抽象名詞，描述在特定情境下失去堅定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite the huge pressure from the judges and the large audience, the young singer did not <target>falter</target> <pattern>in</pattern> her confidence during the final performance.","translation":"儘管面臨評審的巨大壓力與大量觀眾，這位年輕歌手在最終表演期間她的信心絲毫沒有動搖。"},{"sentence":"The brave soldier began to <target>falter</target> <pattern>in</pattern> his resolve when he realized that the enemy army was much larger than he had expected.","translation":"當那名勇敢的士兵意識到敵軍規模比他預想的要大得多時，他的決心開始動搖了。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"falter","pos":"verb","translation":"（聲音）顫抖；（步伐）踉蹌","explanation":"指說話時因為緊張或恐懼而變得不流暢，或走路時因為疲累而失去平衡。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The witness's voice began to <target>falter</target> as he described the scary accident he had seen on the highway last winter.","translation":"當證人描述他去年冬天在高速公路上看到的恐怖事故時，他的聲音開始顫抖了。"},{"sentence":"After walking for ten hours through the deep snow, the exhausted hiker's steps began to <target>falter</target>, and he finally collapsed on the ground.","translation":"在深雪中行走十小時後，疲憊不堪的登山客步伐開始踉蹌，最後終於倒在了地上。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hesitate","pos":"verb","translation":"猶豫；遲疑","explanation":"強調在採取行動前因為不確定而停頓"},{"word":"waver","pos":"verb","translation":"動搖；猶豫","explanation":"強調在兩個選擇之間搖擺不定"},{"word":"stumble","pos":"verb","translation":"踉蹌；結巴","explanation":"指物理上的絆到或說話時的停頓"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"persist","pos":"verb","translation":"堅持","explanation":"強調在困難面前持續進行"},{"word":"persevere","pos":"verb","translation":"堅持不懈","explanation":"強調長期且堅定地追求目標"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"faltered","past_participle":"faltered"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"invariably","explanation":"「invariably」在學測閱讀中常出現於描述科學現象、社會行為模式或人物習慣的段落。它強調的是一種「恆定不變」的規律性，語氣比 always 強烈且更正式，通常用於描述一種必然的結果或重複發生的傾向。","senses":[{"sense":"總是；恆定地","explanation":"指在所有情況下都一樣，沒有例外地發生。","entries":[{"pattern":"invariably + verb/adj.","pos":"adverb","translation":"總是…；恆定地…","explanation":"用來修飾動詞或形容詞，表達某種行為或結果在每次發生時都保持一致，不隨時間或環境而改變。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Whenever the young student feels nervous before a big presentation, he <target>invariably</target> starts to shake his hands slightly.","translation":"每當這位年輕學生在大型簡報前感到緊張時，他總是會開始輕微地顫抖雙手。"},{"sentence":"Despite the different teaching styles of the instructors, the final exam <target>invariably</target> focuses on the core concepts of the textbook.","translation":"儘管指導老師們的教學風格不同，期末考總是集中在教科書的核心概念上。"},{"sentence":"In the rainy season of this tropical island, the morning fog <target>invariably</target> covers the entire valley until the sun rises.","translation":"在這個熱帶島嶼的雨季中，早晨的濃霧總是恆定地覆蓋整個山谷，直到太陽升起。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"always","pos":"adverb","translation":"總是","explanation":"最普遍且通用的表達方式"},{"word":"constantly","pos":"adverb","translation":"不斷地；經常地","explanation":"強調動作頻繁地且持續地發生"},{"word":"consistently","pos":"adverb","translation":"一致地；始終如一地","explanation":"強調在不同時間或情況下保持相同水準或模式"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"occasionally","pos":"adverb","translation":"偶爾地","explanation":"指發生頻率低，且不具備規律性"},{"word":"rarely","pos":"adverb","translation":"很少地","explanation":"極少發生，與恆定性相反"},{"word":"seldom","pos":"adverb","translation":"很少地","explanation":"較正式的用法，指發生頻率極低"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 in- (不) + 字根 vari (改變) + 副詞字尾 -ably","related":[{"word":"variable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可變的；變動的","explanation":"指能夠改變或變動的性質。"},{"word":"variation","pos":"noun","translation":"變化；差異","explanation":"指事物在同一類別中產生的微小差異。"},{"word":"invariant","pos":"adjective","translation":"不變的；恆定的","explanation":"指在任何條件下都保持不變的數值或狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"overhear","explanation":"「overhear」的核心在於「無意間」聽到，這與 intentionally listen (刻意傾聽) 或 eavesdrop (偷聽) 不同。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在敘事類文章中，用來推進情節或揭露角色之間不為人知的秘密。","senses":[{"sense":"無意間聽到","explanation":"在不經意之間聽到他人正在進行的對話，而非刻意去竊聽。","entries":[{"pattern":"overhear sb. doing sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"無意間聽到某人正在做某事","explanation":"常用於描述捕捉到對話的片段或某個特定動作的過程，後接 V-ing 強調動作正在進行。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While walking past the teachers' lounge, I <target>overheard</target> my classmates <pattern>talking</pattern> about the surprise party they were planning for me.","translation":"當我走過教師休息室時，我無意間聽到我的同學正在討論他們正為我籌劃的驚喜派對。"},{"sentence":"The shy student <target>overheard</target> the principal <pattern>discussing</pattern> the new school rules during the break, which made her feel very nervous.","translation":"那名害羞的學生在休息時間無意間聽到校長正在討論新的學校規定，這讓她感到非常緊張。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"overhear that...","pos":"verb","translation":"無意間聽到…（後接子句）","explanation":"後接名詞子句，用來交代無意間獲知的具體資訊或消息內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young journalist <target>overheard</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the famous movie star was secretly visiting the city to meet an old friend.","translation":"這位年輕的記者無意間聽到，那位著名的電影明星正秘密地造訪這座城市以會見一位老友。"},{"sentence":"I <target>overheard</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the science project deadline has been moved to next Friday, so we have more time to finish it.","translation":"我無意間聽到，科學專案的截止日期已移至下週五，所以我們有更多時間來完成它。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"eavesdrop","pos":"verb","translation":"偷聽","explanation":"強調刻意地、偷偷地傾聽他人對話"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"overheard","past_participle":"overheard"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 over- (過度、超過) 與動詞 hear (聽到)","related":[{"word":"overhead","pos":"adjective","translation":"在頭頂上的","explanation":"指位於上方或正上方的位置。"},{"word":"hearing","pos":"noun","translation":"聽力；聽證會","explanation":"由 hear 衍生而來的名詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"pastime","explanation":"「pastime」這個字在學測中常用於描述個人興趣、文化傳統或休閒生活方式。要注意它是由 pass (經過) 和 time (時間) 組合成的字，字面意思是「讓時間流逝的方式」，因此其語意等同於 hobby 或 leisure activity，但語氣上更偏向於一種長期且習慣性的消遣。","senses":[{"sense":"消遣；娛樂；嗜好","explanation":"指在空閒時間中為了享受、放鬆或打發時間而從事的活動。","entries":[{"pattern":"a favorite pastime","pos":"noun","translation":"最喜愛的消遣","explanation":"最常見的搭配，用來描述某人最熱衷的休閒活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"For many elderly people in the small village, playing chess in the park is a <pattern>favorite</pattern> <target>pastime</target> that brings them joy.","translation":"對於那個小村莊裡的許多年長者來說，在公園裡下棋是一項最喜愛的消遣，能帶給他們快樂。"},{"sentence":"Reading historical novels became her <pattern>favorite</pattern> <target>pastime</target> during the long summer break when she had nothing else to do.","translation":"在漫長的暑假期間，當她無事可做時，閱讀歷史小說成了她最喜愛的消遣。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"pastime","pos":"noun","translation":"消遣；嗜好","explanation":"作為單純的名詞使用，指任何形式的休閒活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Collecting rare stamps from different countries was a popular <target>pastime</target> for many people before the internet changed how we spend our time.","translation":"在互聯網改變我們利用時間的方式之前，收集來自不同國家的稀有郵票曾是許多人流行的消遣。"},{"sentence":"Watching professional basketball games has become a national <target>pastime</target> in the United States, attracting millions of fans every year.","translation":"觀看職業籃球賽事已成為美國的一項國民消遣，每年吸引數百萬名球迷。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hobby","pos":"noun","translation":"嗜好；興趣","explanation":"最普遍的同義詞，強調個人對某項活動的熱情"},{"word":"leisure activity","pos":"noun","translation":"休閒活動","explanation":"強調在非工作時間進行的活動"},{"word":"recreation","pos":"noun","translation":"娛樂；消遣","explanation":"較正式的詞彙，指為了恢復體力或精神而進行的活動"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 pass (經過) + 名詞 time (時間)","related":[{"word":"leisure","pos":"noun","translation":"閒暇；悠閒","explanation":"雖然非同根，但語意密切相關，常用於 leisure time"}]}}

{"headword":"sculptor","explanation":"「sculptor」是指創造雕塑作品的藝術家。在學測中，此字常出現在藝術史、文化遺產或個人傳記類文章中。學生應注意其動詞形式 sculpt 以及相關的藝術名詞如 sculpture (雕塑品) 的區分。","senses":[{"sense":"雕刻家；雕塑家","explanation":"利用石材、金屬、木材或黏土等媒介創造三維藝術作品的人。","entries":[{"pattern":"sculptor","pos":"noun","translation":"雕刻家；雕塑家","explanation":"指從事雕刻藝術的專業人員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The famous Italian <target>sculptor</target> spent several years carefully carving a giant piece of white marble into a beautiful statue.","translation":"那位著名的義大利雕刻家花了好幾年時間，小心翼翼地將一塊巨大的白色大理石雕刻成一座美麗的雕像。"},{"sentence":"After visiting the museum, the students were amazed by how the <target>sculptor</target> could make hard stone look like soft, flowing fabric.","translation":"參觀博物館後，學生們對雕刻家如何能讓堅硬的石頭看起來像柔軟且流動的布料感到驚訝。"},{"sentence":"The local <target>sculptor</target> decided to use recycled plastic waste to create a modern art piece that warns people about ocean pollution.","translation":"這位當地的雕塑家決定使用回收的塑料廢棄物來創作一件現代藝術品，用以警告人們關於海洋污染的問題。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"artist","pos":"noun","translation":"藝術家","explanation":"泛指所有從事藝術創作的人，包含畫家、雕刻家等"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 sculpt (雕刻) + 名詞字尾 -or (人)","related":[{"word":"sculpt","pos":"verb","translation":"雕刻；塑造","explanation":"指用工具將材料剔除或塑造出形狀的動作。"},{"word":"sculpture","pos":"noun","translation":"雕塑；雕塑品","explanation":"指雕刻家創作出的三維藝術成品。"}]}}

{"headword":"splendor","explanation":"「splendor」在學測中常用於描述壯麗的自然景觀、宏偉的建築或盛大的儀式。它不僅指視覺上的「華麗」，更包含一種令人震撼的「光輝」或「壯麗感」。","senses":[{"sense":"壯麗；光輝；華麗","explanation":"指事物展現出的極其宏偉、華麗或光彩奪目的狀態。","entries":[{"pattern":"the splendor of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的壯麗／光輝","explanation":"最常見的用法，通常接自然景觀（如山脈、日落）或藝術建築（如宮殿、教堂）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After hiking for six hours, the travelers were completely amazed by the natural <target>splendor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the snow-capped mountains.","translation":"在徒步旅行六個小時後，旅人們完全被那些被雪覆蓋的山脈的自然壯麗所震撼。"},{"sentence":"The tourists spent the entire afternoon admiring the golden <target>splendor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the ancient palace and its detailed carvings.","translation":"遊客們花了一整個下午欣賞這座古老宮殿的金色華麗及其精細的雕刻。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"in all its splendor","pos":"noun","translation":"展現出全部的壯麗／光輝","explanation":"固定片語，用來強調某物在最完美的狀態下被完整地呈現出來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the spring sun finally arrived, the royal garden was revealed <pattern>in</pattern> all its <target>splendor</target>, with thousands of colorful flowers blooming at once.","translation":"當春季的陽光終於到來時，皇家花園展現出全部的壯麗，成千上萬朵五彩繽紛的花朵同時綻放。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"magnificence","pos":"noun","translation":"壯麗；宏偉","explanation":"強調規模宏大且令人印象深刻"},{"word":"grandeur","pos":"noun","translation":"莊嚴；宏偉","explanation":"強調一種高貴且具有威嚴感的壯麗"},{"word":"brilliance","pos":"noun","translation":"光輝；燦爛","explanation":"強調光線的強烈或色彩的鮮艷"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"plainness","pos":"noun","translation":"樸素；單調","explanation":null},{"word":"drabness","pos":"noun","translation":"單調；陰暗","explanation":null}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"來自形容詞 splendid (壯麗的) 加上名詞字尾 -or","related":[{"word":"splendid","pos":"adjective","translation":"壯麗的；極好的","explanation":"核心形容詞型態，可用於描述風景、天氣或表現。"}]}}

{"headword":"spokesperson","explanation":"「spokesperson」是一個性別中立的詞彙，取代了較早期的 spokesperson (男) 或 spokeswoman (女)。在學測閱讀中，此字常出現在新聞報導、政府公告或企業聲明等正式情境中，用以指代那些被授權代表組織發言的人。","senses":[{"sense":"發言人","explanation":"代表某個公司、政府、組織或特定個人對外發表正式聲明或提供資訊的人。","entries":[{"pattern":"spokesperson for sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的發言人","explanation":"使用介系詞 for 來表明該發言人所代表的對象（組織、機構或領導者）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"A <target>spokesperson</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the Ministry of Education announced that all high school students would receive new tablets for digital learning.","translation":"教育部的發言人宣布，所有高中生都將收到用於數位學習的新平板電腦。"},{"sentence":"The <target>spokesperson</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the tech company denied all rumors about the upcoming product launch, stating that the date was still secret.","translation":"該科技公司的發言人否認了所有關於即將推出之產品的傳聞，聲明日期仍是秘密。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"act as a spokesperson","pos":"noun","translation":"擔任發言人","explanation":"常用於描述某人被選中或被委任來代表他人發言。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she speaks four languages fluently, the young diplomat was chosen to <target>act as a spokesperson</target> for the international environmental group.","translation":"因為她能流利地說四種語言，這位年輕的外交官被選中擔任該國際環境組織的發言人。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"representative","pos":"noun","translation":"代表","explanation":"較泛指任何代表某人或某組織的人"},{"word":"mouthpiece","pos":"noun","translation":"發言人；喉舌","explanation":"有時帶有負面含義，指僅僅重複他人指令而無自主權的人"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 speak (說) 的衍生型態 + 詞綴 -person (人)","related":[{"word":"spokesman","pos":"noun","translation":"男發言人","explanation":"傳統的性別特定稱呼。"},{"word":"spokeswoman","pos":"noun","translation":"女發言人","explanation":"傳統的性別特定稱呼。"}]}}

{"headword":"spokesman","explanation":"「spokesman」在學測閱讀中常出現在新聞報導或企業公告等語境中，指代表特定組織、政府或名人的官方發言人。需注意其性別中立的替代詞「spokesperson」在現代英文中更為普遍，但在考題中兩者通用。","senses":[{"sense":"發言人","explanation":"被授權代表一個團體或個人對外發表正式聲明的人。","entries":[{"pattern":"a spokesman for sth./sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的發言人","explanation":"最常見的用法，後方接代表的對象（如公司、政府、或某位名人）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"A <target>spokesman</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the Ministry of Health stated that the new vaccine is safe and effective for all age groups.","translation":"衛生部的發言人表示，新款疫苗對所有年齡層的人來說都是安全且有效的。"},{"sentence":"The company hired a professional <target>spokesman</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the famous singer to handle all the media interviews during the tour.","translation":"這間公司為那位著名歌手聘請了一名專業發言人，以便在巡演期間處理所有的媒體採訪。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"act as a spokesman","pos":"noun","translation":"擔任發言人","explanation":"強調扮演這個角色或執行此項職責。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the emergency press conference, the vice president had to <target>act as a spokesman</target> while the president was recovering from surgery.","translation":"在緊急記者會期間，由於總統正在手術後恢復中，副總統必須擔任發言人。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"spokesperson","pos":"noun","translation":"發言人","explanation":"性別中立的用語，目前在正式文書中比 spokesman 更常見"},{"word":"representative","pos":"noun","translation":"代表","explanation":"泛指代表某組織的人，不一定僅限於對外發言"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 speak (說) 的過去分詞形式 spoken (被說/發言) + 名詞後綴 -man (人)","related":[{"word":"speak","pos":"verb","translation":"說；講話","explanation":"基礎動詞，spokesman 的核心語義來源。"},{"word":"spokeswoman","pos":"noun","translation":"女性發言人","explanation":"專指女性的發言人。"}]}}

{"headword":"spontaneous","explanation":"「spontaneous」在學測中常用於描述人的性格、行為反應或自然現象。其核心概念是「非預先計畫」且「自然發生」的。在閱讀測驗中，常出現於心理學文章或描述個人成長的敘事文中。","senses":[{"sense":"自然發生的；自發性的","explanation":"指不需要外界壓力或預先計畫，而是在內心衝動或自然條件下產生的行為或狀態。","entries":[{"pattern":"spontaneous reaction","pos":"adjective","translation":"自然的反應","explanation":"指面對突發狀況時，不經思考而立即產生的直覺反應。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the singer suddenly stepped off the stage and hugged the fans, the audience had a <target>spontaneous</target> <pattern>reaction</pattern> of loud cheering.","translation":"當歌手突然走下舞台擁抱粉絲時，觀眾產生了熱烈歡呼的自然反應。"},{"sentence":"The dog's <target>spontaneous</target> <pattern>reaction</pattern> to the loud thunder was to hide under the sofa and shake with fear.","translation":"那隻狗對劇烈雷聲的自然反應就是躲在沙發下瑟瑟發抖。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"be spontaneous","pos":"adjective","translation":"隨興的；自然而然的","explanation":"用來描述一個人不喜歡死板的計畫，傾向於根據當下的心情決定行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My sister is very <target>spontaneous</target>; she often decides to take a trip to the mountains without booking a hotel in advance.","translation":"我姊姊非常隨興；她經常在沒有預先訂房的情況下，決定去山區旅行。"},{"sentence":"Some students prefer a strict schedule, but others are more <target>spontaneous</target> and enjoy exploring the city without a map.","translation":"有些學生偏好嚴格的日程表，但有些人則較為隨興，喜歡在沒有地圖的情況下探索城市。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"spontaneous combustion","pos":"adjective","translation":"自燃","explanation":"科學術語，指物質在沒有外部火源的情況下，由於內部化學反應而自動起火。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The science teacher explained that certain chemicals can undergo <target>spontaneous</target> <pattern>combustion</pattern> if they are stored in a warm and humid environment.","translation":"科學老師解釋說，某些化學物質如果在溫暖潮濕的環境中存放，可能會發生自燃。"},{"sentence":"Firefighters warned the factory that piles of oily rags can lead to <target>spontaneous</target> <pattern>combustion</pattern> and cause dangerous fires.","translation":"消防員警告工廠，堆積的油膩抹布可能會導致自燃並引起危險的火災。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"impulsive","pos":"adjective","translation":"衝動的","explanation":"強調不經思考就行動，通常帶有輕微的負面含義"},{"word":"unplanned","pos":"adjective","translation":"非計畫的","explanation":"單純描述事情沒有經過預先安排"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"planned","pos":"adjective","translation":"有計畫的","explanation":null},{"word":"calculated","pos":"adjective","translation":"經過計算的；深思熟慮的","explanation":"強調每一步都經過精密計算"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 spontan (自發的) + 形容詞字尾 -ous","related":[{"word":"spontaneity","pos":"noun","translation":"自發性；自然而然","explanation":"由形容詞 spontaneous 轉化而來的名詞型態。"},{"word":"spontaneously","pos":"adverb","translation":"自發地；自然而然地","explanation":"由形容詞 spontaneous 轉化而來的副詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"sportsmanship","explanation":"「sportsmanship」是指在體育競賽或競爭環境中表現出的公正、誠實與尊重對手的精神。在學測中，此字常用於討論道德、團隊合作以及面對勝敗的態度。","senses":[{"sense":"運動精神；公正競爭的精神","explanation":"指在比賽中遵守規則、不作弊，並且無論勝敗都對對手展現尊重與禮貌的態度。","entries":[{"pattern":"show / demonstrate sportsmanship","pos":"noun","translation":"展現運動精神","explanation":"常用於描述運動員在比賽結束後或在爭議判決時表現出的高尚態度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the intense final match, the winner shook hands with his opponent and <target>demonstrated</target> great <pattern>sportsmanship</pattern> by praising the other team's hard work.","translation":"在激烈的決賽後，獲勝者與對手握手，並透過稱讚對方球隊的努力而展現了極佳的運動精神。"},{"sentence":"The young tennis player <target>showed</target> amazing <pattern>sportsmanship</pattern> when she stopped playing to help her injured rival stand up and walk off the court.","translation":"當那名年輕的網球選手停止比賽以幫助受傷的對手站起來並走離球場時，她展現了令人驚嘆的運動精神。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"lack of sportsmanship","pos":"noun","translation":"缺乏運動精神","explanation":"用於描述不公正的行為，例如在比賽中爭論判決、嘲笑對手或故意犯規。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The coach was deeply disappointed by the <pattern>lack</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>sportsmanship</target> shown by his players, who laughed at the losing team after the game.","translation":"教練對他的球員所展現出的缺乏運動精神感到深感失望，因為他們在比賽結束後嘲笑落敗的球隊。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fair play","pos":"noun","translation":"公平競爭","explanation":"強調遵守規則且不採取不公平手段"},{"word":"integrity","pos":"noun","translation":"誠信；正直","explanation":"泛指在任何情況下都保持誠實與道德的高尚品質"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unsportsmanlike conduct","pos":"noun","translation":"不符合運動精神的行為","explanation":"指違反公平競爭原則的行為"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 sport (運動) + man (人) + 字尾 -ship (狀態、性質、能力)","related":[{"word":"sportsman","pos":"noun","translation":"運動員","explanation":"指參與體育活動的人。"},{"word":"sportsmanlike","pos":"adjective","translation":"符合運動精神的","explanation":"由名詞 sportsmanship 延伸而來的形容詞，描述行為符合公正競爭原則。"}]}}

{"headword":"homosexual","explanation":"「homosexual」是一個較為正式且具有生物學或醫學色彩的詞彙，用來描述性傾向。在學測閱讀中，常出現於社會科學、心理學或人權討論的篇章中。要注意其作為形容詞與名詞的用法區分。","senses":[{"sense":"同性戀的；同性戀者","explanation":"指對同性產生情感或性吸引力的傾向。","entries":[{"pattern":"homosexual","pos":"adjective","translation":"同性戀的","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，描述一個人的性傾向或一種特定的關係。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In many modern societies, people are becoming more accepting of <target>homosexual</target> relationships and the rights of the LGBTQ+ community.","translation":"在許多現代社會中，人們對於同性戀關係以及 LGBTQ+ 社群的權利變得越來越包容。"},{"sentence":"The sociology student wrote a detailed report on how <target>homosexual</target> behavior is observed in hundreds of different animal species.","translation":"這位社會學學生寫了一份詳細的報告，探討在數百種不同的動物物種中如何觀察到同性戀行為。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"a homosexual","pos":"noun","translation":"同性戀者","explanation":"指具有同性戀傾向的人。但在現代口語或非正式社交場合中，使用 gay 或 lesbian 較為自然且不具醫療感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite being <target>a homosexual</target>, the young man found that his community supported him fully when he decided to come out.","translation":"儘管是一名同性戀者，這位年輕人在決定出櫃時發現他的社區完全支持他。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"gay","pos":"adjective","translation":"同性戀的","explanation":"最普遍且中性的現代常用詞"},{"word":"lesbian","pos":"adjective","translation":"女同性戀的","explanation":"專指女性同性戀者"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"heterosexual","pos":"adjective","translation":"異性戀的","explanation":"指對異性產生吸引力"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 homo- (相同) + 字根 sexual (關於性的)","related":[{"word":"homogeneity","pos":"noun","translation":"同質性","explanation":"指成分或性質相同的情況"},{"word":"homogeneous","pos":"adjective","translation":"同質的","explanation":"指由相同種類之物組成"},{"word":"heterosexual","pos":"adjective","translation":"異性戀的","explanation":"字首 hetero- (不同) 與 homosexual 相對立"}]}}

{"headword":"honorary","explanation":"「honorary」在學測中常用於描述職稱或獎項，強調該身份是為了「表示榮譽」而授予的，而非透過常規的競爭、選舉或實際工作獲取。理解此字的核心在於區分「名義上的」與「實際執行的」。","senses":[{"sense":"名義上的；榮譽的","explanation":"指授予某人某個職位或稱號，以表彰其成就或貢獻，但該職位通常不涉及實際的日常工作或薪水。","entries":[{"pattern":"honorary degree","pos":"adjective","translation":"名譽學位","explanation":"指大學授予對社會有重大貢獻的人，而不需要對方經過正式學術研究或修課畢業的學位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she spent her entire life helping poor children in Africa, the university decided to grant her an <target>honorary</target> <pattern>degree</pattern> in peace studies.","translation":"因為她一生都在幫助非洲的貧困兒童，這所大學決定授予她一個和平研究的名譽學位。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"honorary president / chairman","pos":"adjective","translation":"名譽會長／名譽主席","explanation":"指某人雖然擁有這個高級職稱，但不再負責實際的日常管理工作，僅作為組織的象徵或精神領袖。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After retiring from the company, the founder was named the <target>honorary</target> <pattern>president</pattern> to show respect for his lifelong hard work and leadership.","translation":"在從公司退休後，創辦人被任命為名譽會長，以表達對他一生辛勤工作與領導力的尊重。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"titular","pos":"adjective","translation":"名義上的","explanation":"強調僅有頭銜而無實權"},{"word":"symbolic","pos":"adjective","translation":"象徵性的","explanation":"強調該身份僅作為一種象徵"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 honor (榮譽) + 形容詞字尾 -ary","related":[{"word":"honor","pos":"noun","translation":"榮譽；名聲","explanation":"核心基礎名詞。"},{"word":"honorable","pos":"adjective","translation":"值得尊敬的；光榮的","explanation":"指人的品格正直、值得尊敬，與 honorary 的名義授予性質不同。"},{"word":"honorarium","pos":"noun","translation":"酬金；謝禮","explanation":"給予提供免費服務之人的小額金錢報酬。"}]}}

{"headword":"hospitality","explanation":"「hospitality」在學測中常出現在旅遊、文化交流或社會互動的閱讀文章中。它不僅指物理上的「招待」，更強調一種慷慨、友善且讓客人在心裡感到舒適的待客精神。","senses":[{"sense":"款待；招待","explanation":"指對客人（尤其是陌生人或外來者）表現出的友善、慷慨且大方的接待方式。","entries":[{"pattern":"hospitality","pos":"noun","translation":"款待；招待","explanation":"指一種待客的行為或品質，常用於描述一個家庭、一個城市或一個國家對外來者的態度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The local villagers welcomed the foreign tourists with warm <target>hospitality</target>, providing them with fresh food and a cozy place to sleep.","translation":"當地村民以熱情的款待迎接外國遊客，為他們提供了新鮮的食物和舒適的睡眠之處。"},{"sentence":"During my first visit to the mountain town, I was deeply touched by the incredible <target>hospitality</target> of the people who lived there.","translation":"在我第一次訪問那個山城時，我被當地居民令人驚嘆的熱情款待深深觸動。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"hospitality industry","pos":"noun","translation":"觀光服務業／款待業","explanation":"這是一個專業術語，涵蓋了飯店、餐廳、旅遊代理等所有以提供服務與舒適感為核心的商業產業。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students decide to study tourism management because they want to build a successful career in the global <target>hospitality</target> <pattern>industry</pattern>.","translation":"許多學生決定學習觀光管理，因為他們希望在全球的觀光服務業中建立成功的事業。"},{"sentence":"The hotel manager explained that providing a high standard of service is the most important part of the <target>hospitality</target> <pattern>industry</pattern>.","translation":"飯店經理解釋說，提供高標準的服務是款待業（觀光服務業）最重要的部分。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"welcome","pos":"noun","translation":"歡迎；接待","explanation":"指對客人的歡迎態度"},{"word":"generosity","pos":"noun","translation":"慷慨；大方","explanation":"強調款待時表現出的不吝於提供資源的特質"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"hostility","pos":"noun","translation":"敵意；不友善","explanation":"指對他人表現出反感、敵對或不友善的態度"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 延伸而來的形容詞，用來描述人或環境讓人感到舒適。"},{"word":"hospital","pos":"noun","translation":"醫院","explanation":"字面意為照顧客人的地方，後來演變為照顧病人的醫療機構。"},{"word":"host","pos":"noun","translation":"主人；主辦人","explanation":"招待客人的主體。"}]}}

{"headword":"hostel","explanation":"「hostel」通常指專為年輕旅人、學生或背包客設計的低價住宿，與一般的 hotel（飯店）不同，其核心特徵是「共享空間」（如宿舍房 shared dorms）。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在旅遊、青年文化或預算管理等主題中。","senses":[{"sense":"青年旅館；廉價旅店","explanation":"一種提供簡單住宿且價格低廉的旅店，房客通常共用房間與衛浴設施。","entries":[{"pattern":"stay at a hostel","pos":"noun","translation":"住在青年旅館","explanation":"最基礎的用法，描述旅途中選擇低預算住宿方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the college students had a very limited budget for their summer trip, they decided to <pattern>stay</pattern> <pattern>at</pattern> a <target>hostel</target> instead of a fancy hotel.","translation":"因為大學生們的夏季旅行預算非常有限，他們決定住在青年旅館，而不是豪華飯店。"},{"sentence":"Many backpackers prefer to stay at a <target>hostel</target> because it is a great way to meet other travelers from all over the world.","translation":"許多背包客喜歡住在青年旅館，因為這是結識來自世界各地其他旅人的絕佳方式。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"hostel dorms / shared rooms","pos":"noun","translation":"青旅宿舍房／共用房","explanation":"指青旅中典型的多人共用床位之房間，強調共享空間的特質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To save more money for sightseeing, the young couple booked a bed in a <target>hostel</target> <pattern>dorm</pattern>, where they shared a room with five strangers.","translation":"為了省下更多錢用來觀光，這對年輕情侶在青年旅館預訂了一張宿舍床位，在那裡他們與五個陌生人共用一個房間。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"inn","pos":"noun","translation":"小旅店","explanation":"通常指鄉間較小且較傳統的旅店"},{"word":"guest house","pos":"noun","translation":"民宿；招待所","explanation":"提供居家氛圍的廉價住宿"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"hotel","pos":"noun","translation":"飯店／酒店","explanation":"通常指設施較完整且價格較高的商業住宿"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"hospitality","pos":"noun","translation":"好客；款待","explanation":"雖然拼法相近，但 hospitality 來自拉丁語 hospes (客人)，強調款待之情。"}]}}

{"headword":"hygiene","explanation":"「hygiene」在學測中常出現在健康、公共衛生或個人生活習慣的討論中。學生需區分 hygiene（衛生習慣/做法）與 sanitary（衛生的/環境乾淨的）的細微差異：前者更強調「維持健康的行為」，後者更強調「環境的潔淨度」。","senses":[{"sense":"衛生習慣；公共衛生","explanation":"指為了維持健康而採取的清潔做法或習慣。","entries":[{"pattern":"personal hygiene","pos":"noun","translation":"個人衛生","explanation":"指洗澡、刷牙、洗手等個人清潔習慣，是健康教育中最基礎的搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Doctors always remind students that maintaining good <pattern>personal</pattern> <target>hygiene</target> is the best way to prevent the spread of common colds.","translation":"醫生總是提醒學生，維持良好的個人衛生是預防感冒傳播的最佳方式。"},{"sentence":"The teacher taught the kindergarten children how to wash their hands properly as part of their basic <pattern>personal</pattern> <target>hygiene</target> lessons.","translation":"老師將正確洗手的方法作為基礎個人衛生課程的一部分，教給了幼稚園的孩子們。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"public hygiene","pos":"noun","translation":"公共衛生","explanation":"指城市、社區或國家層級的清潔與健康管理系統。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The city government spent millions of dollars to improve <pattern>public</pattern> <target>hygiene</target> by building more modern waste treatment plants.","translation":"市政府花費數百萬美元，透過建造更多現代化的廢棄物處理廠來改善公共衛生。"},{"sentence":"During the heavy rainy season, keeping the streets clean and the drains clear is essential for maintaining overall <pattern>public</pattern> <target>hygiene</target>.","translation":"在強降雨季節，保持街道乾淨且排水溝暢通對於維持整體的公共衛生至關重要。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cleanliness","pos":"noun","translation":"清潔；潔淨","explanation":"較泛指環境或身體的乾淨狀態"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自希臘語 hygieia (健康女神)","related":[{"word":"hygienic","pos":"adjective","translation":"衛生的","explanation":"形容詞形式，指符合衛生標準的。"},{"word":"unhygienic","pos":"adjective","translation":"不衛生的","explanation":"指環境或做法不符合衛生標準，容易導致疾病。"}]}}

{"headword":"hypocrite","explanation":"「hypocrite」是一個帶有強烈負面評價的字，指那些言行不一、表面上表現得高尚但私下卻相反的人。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在關於道德討論、人物性格分析或社會批判的文章中。重點在於區分其名詞形式 hypocrite 與形容詞形式 hypocritical。","senses":[{"sense":"偽君子；虛偽的人","explanation":"指一個人聲稱擁有某些美德或信念，但實際上卻沒有或不按照這些信念行事。","entries":[{"pattern":"be a hypocrite","pos":"noun","translation":"是個偽君子","explanation":"最基本的用法，直接將此名詞作為表語，用來定義一個人的道德缺陷。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The politician promised to protect the environment, but he <pattern>was</pattern> a <target>hypocrite</target> because he flew his private jet every single day.","translation":"這位政治家承諾要保護環境，但他卻是個偽君子，因為他每天都乘坐私人飛機。"},{"sentence":"It is hard to trust a leader who <pattern>is</pattern> a <target>hypocrite</target>, as his words and actions never seem to align with each other.","translation":"很難信任一個是偽君子的領導者，因為他的話語和行動似乎從未一致過。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"phoney","pos":"noun","translation":"騙子；虛偽的人","explanation":"較口語，指人表面上裝作某種樣子但並非事實"},{"word":"fraud","pos":"noun","translation":"騙子","explanation":"指一個人的能力或身份是完全偽造的"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"sincere","pos":"adjective","translation":"真誠的","explanation":"雖然詞性不同，但意義上完全相反，指內心與外在表現一致"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 hypo- (在…之下) + kryte (演員/隱藏)","related":[{"word":"hypocritical","pos":"adjective","translation":"虛偽的","explanation":"由名詞 hypocrite 加上形容詞字尾 -ical 延伸而來。"},{"word":"hypocrisy","pos":"noun","translation":"虛偽；偽善","explanation":"指虛偽這種行為或狀態的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"imminent","explanation":"「imminent」主要用於描述即將發生的「負面」或「重大」事件。在學測閱讀中，常出現在描述自然災害、戰爭、危機或緊迫期限的語境中。學生應將其與「eminent」（卓越的）區分開來，以免混淆。","senses":[{"sense":"即將發生的；迫在眉睫的","explanation":"指某事（通常是不太愉快的事）很快就會發生，且幾乎不可避免。","entries":[{"pattern":"imminent danger","pos":"adjective","translation":"迫在眉睫的危險","explanation":"最常見的強搭配，用於描述面臨立即威脅的緊急狀況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the dark clouds gathered and the wind began to howl, the sailors realized that a violent storm was <target>imminent</target> <pattern>danger</pattern>.","translation":"當烏雲聚集且風開始咆哮時，水手們意識到一場劇烈的風暴是迫在眉睫的危險。"},{"sentence":"The forest rangers warned the tourists that the <target>imminent</target> <pattern>danger</pattern> of a landslide was high due to the heavy rain.","translation":"森林管理員警告遊客，由於大雨，發生山崩的迫在眉睫之危險很高。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"be imminent","pos":"adjective","translation":"即將發生","explanation":"作表語使用，直接描述某個事件（如災難、改變、期限）即將到來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"With the final exams approaching next week, many students feel that a period of intense stress and late-night studying is <target>imminent</target>.","translation":"隨著期末考在下週逼近，許多學生感覺一段高壓與熬夜讀書的時期即將到來。"},{"sentence":"The government issued an urgent warning to all citizens because a massive volcanic eruption appeared to be <target>imminent</target>.","translation":"政府向所有公民發布緊急警告，因為一次大規模的火山爆發似乎即將發生。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"impending","pos":"adjective","translation":"即將到來的","explanation":"語義幾乎相同，常用於描述令人不安的事件"},{"word":"forthcoming","pos":"adjective","translation":"即將到來的","explanation":"較為中性，可用於描述計畫好的活動或書籍"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"distant","pos":"adjective","translation":"遙遠的","explanation":"指時間或空間上距離很遠"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 immin- (突現) + 字尾 -ent (形容詞)","related":[{"word":"imminence","pos":"noun","translation":"即將發生；迫在眉睫","explanation":"由形容詞 imminent 轉化而來的名詞形態。"}]}}

{"headword":"imperative","explanation":"「imperative」在學測中是一個高階形容詞，最常出現於論述文或建議文中。其核心概念是「緊急且必須」的。當它作為形容詞時，常與 it is imperative that... 句型搭配；當它作為名詞時，則指一種「命令」或「必要條件」。","senses":[{"sense":"至關重要的；迫切的","explanation":"指某件事在目前情況下是絕對必要且不能延遲的。","entries":[{"pattern":"it is imperative that... (should) do","pos":"adjective","translation":"…是至關重要的／迫切的","explanation":"這是學測最核心的語法考點。that 子句中必須使用虛擬語氣，動詞應使用原型動詞（即省略了 should）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Given the rapid rise in sea levels, it is <target>imperative</target> <pattern>that</pattern> governments <pattern>take</pattern> immediate action to protect coastal cities.","translation":"鑑於海平面快速上升，政府立即採取行動保護沿海城市是至關重要的。"},{"sentence":"To need","pos":"adjective","translation":"迫切的需求","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，強調該需求在時間上或邏輯上是不可或缺的。","sentences":[{"sentence":"With the city's water supply running low, there is an <target>imperative</target> reducing plastic waste is a moral <target>imperative</target> to save the planet for future generations.","translation":"許多環保主義者認為，減少塑膠廢棄物是為了給後代保存地球而必須履行的道德責任。"},{"sentence":"For a small business to {"headword":"oasis","explanation":"「oasis」在學測中通常以兩種方式出現：一是地理上的「綠洲」，二是比喻意義上的「避風港」或「寧靜之處」。在閱讀測驗中，看到此字常與沙漠、乾旱或壓力巨大的環境形成強烈對比。","senses":[{"sense":"綠洲","explanation":"沙漠中擁有水源且植物生長的肥沃地區。","entries":[{"pattern":"oasis","pos":"noun","translation":"綠洲","explanation":"指地理上在乾旱地區中出現的水源地，通常伴隨棕櫚樹等植被。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After traveling for three long days through the burning desert, the thirsty travelers finally spotted a lush <target>oasis</target> in the distance.","translation":"在灼熱的沙漠中行走三天後，口渴的旅人終於在遠方發現了一片茂盛的綠洲。"},{"sentence":"The small village was built around a natural <target>oasis</target>, where fresh water springs from the ground to support the local date palms.","translation":"這個小村莊是圍繞著一個天然綠洲而建的，在那裡新鮮的水源從地下湧出，以維持當地海棗樹的生長。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fertile spot","pos":"noun","translation":"肥沃之地","explanation":"指在乾旱處出現的綠色地帶"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"避風港；寧靜之處","explanation":"比喻指在繁忙、嘈雜或壓力巨大的環境中，一個能讓人感到放鬆與平靜的地方或狀態。","entries":[{"pattern":"an oasis of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"（某種感覺的）避風港；寧靜之處","explanation":"常用於 an oasis of peace / calm / quiet 這種搭配，用來描述在混亂之中找到的平靜。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The quiet public library became a welcome <target>oasis</target> <pattern>of</pattern> peace for the student who had to deal with noisy neighbors every day.","translation":"對於每天必須面對吵鬧鄰居的學生來說，安靜的公共圖書館成了一個令人欣喜的寧靜之處。"},{"sentence":"For the exhausted office worker, a ten-minute walk through the city park was a small <target>oasis</target> <pattern>of</pattern> calm in a stressful day.","translation":"對於疲憊的上班族來說，在城市公園裡散步十分鐘，是壓力山大的一天中一個小小的寧靜避風港。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sanctuary","pos":"noun","translation":"避難所；聖所","explanation":"強調安全且不受干擾的地方"},{"word":"haven","pos":"noun","translation":"避風港","explanation":"指能提供保護或安適之處"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"oatmeal","explanation":"「oatmeal」在學測中常出現在與健康飲食、營養學或日常生活作息相關的閱讀文章中。它既可以用作不可數名詞指代「燕麥片」這種食材，也可以指代用燕麥片煮成的「燕麥粥」。","senses":[{"sense":"燕麥片；燕麥粥","explanation":"指將燕麥籽經過加工後壓扁成的片狀食物，或將其與水或牛奶煮成的粥品。","entries":[{"pattern":"oatmeal","pos":"noun","translation":"燕麥片；燕麥粥","explanation":"作為不可數名詞，描述一種健康的早餐選擇。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many health experts suggest eating a bowl of warm <target>oatmeal</target> for breakfast because it keeps you full until lunchtime.","translation":"許多健康專家建議早餐吃一碗溫熱的燕麥粥，因為它能讓你飽足直到午餐時間。"},{"sentence":"To make the meal more delicious, she added fresh blueberries and a spoonful of honey to her morning <target>oatmeal</target>.","translation":"為了讓這頓餐點更美味，她在早晨的燕麥粥中加入了新鮮的藍莓和一勺蜂蜜。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"porridge","pos":"noun","translation":"粥；糊狀食物","explanation":"泛指用穀物煮成的粥，oatmeal 是其中最常見的一種"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由 oat (燕麥) 與 meal (磨碎的穀物) 組成","related":[{"word":"oat","pos":"noun","translation":"燕麥","explanation":"指燕麥這種植物或其種子。"}]}}

{"headword":"odor","explanation":"「odor」通常指一種強烈的、且往往是不太愉快的氣味。在學測中，此字常出現在科學描述（如化學反應、生物分解）或環境議題（如垃圾處理、污染）的文本中。注意它與 smell 的區別：smell 是中性詞，而 odor 傾向於負面或具有特定化學特徵的氣味。","senses":[{"sense":"氣味；氣息","explanation":"指散發在空氣中的強烈氣味，尤其是令人不快或具有辨識度的化學味道。","entries":[{"pattern":"strong / pungent odor","pos":"noun","translation":"強烈／刺鼻的氣味","explanation":"常用於描述化學物質、腐敗物質或強烈香料產生的氣味。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As soon as the scientist opened the container, a <pattern>strong</pattern> <target>odor</target> of sulfur filled the small laboratory, making everyone cough.","translation":"科學家一打開容器，一股強烈的硫磺味便充滿了小型實驗室，讓每個人都咳嗽。"},{"sentence":"The old gym bag had been left in the locker for months, and now it gave off a <pattern>pungent</pattern> <target>odor</target> of sweat and mold.","translation":"那個舊運動包在儲物櫃裡放了幾個月，現在散發出一股刺鼻的汗味與霉味。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"eliminate / remove the odor","pos":"noun","translation":"消除氣味","explanation":"常用於描述清潔產品、空氣清新劑或環境治理的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hotel management installed new air filters to <target>eliminate</target> the unpleasant <pattern>odor</pattern> of cigarette smoke from the guest rooms.","translation":"飯店管理層安裝了新的空氣過濾器，以消除客房中令人不快之菸味。"},{"sentence":"Many people use baking soda because it is a cheap and effective way to <pattern>remove</pattern> the <target>odor</target> of old fish from the kitchen.","translation":"許多人使用小蘇打，因為它是消除廚房中舊魚腥味的一種廉價且有效的方法。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"scent","pos":"noun","translation":"香味；氣味","explanation":"通常指令人愉快的氣味，如花香或香水"},{"word":"aroma","pos":"noun","translation":"芳香","explanation":"專指令人愉悅且濃郁的氣味，常用於食物或咖啡"},{"word":"stink","pos":"noun","translation":"臭味","explanation":"非常非正式且強烈的負面氣味"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"odorous","pos":"adjective","translation":"有氣味的","explanation":"由名詞 odor 加上形容詞字尾 -ous 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"offspring","explanation":"「offspring」在學測中常出現在生物科學、自然環境或家庭關係的閱讀文章中。最關鍵的文法考點在於其「單複數同形」的特性：無論是指單一個後代還是多個後代，形式均不改變，因此在使用時需根據上下文的動詞或量詞來判斷數量。","senses":[{"sense":"後代；子嗣","explanation":"指動物或人類的子女、後代，涵蓋了生物學上的繁衍結果。","entries":[{"pattern":"offspring","pos":"noun","translation":"後代；子嗣","explanation":"作為可數名詞使用，但形式不分單複數，常用於描述動物繁衍或遺傳特徵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The mother bear carefully guarded her <target>offspring</target> from dangerous predators to ensure they could survive the harsh winter.","translation":"母熊小心地守護著她的後代，以免遭到危險掠食者的攻擊，以確保牠們能度過嚴酷的冬天。"},{"sentence":"Many birds build complex nests and spend weeks feeding their <target>offspring</target> until the young ones can fly on their own.","translation":"許多鳥類建造複雜的巢穴並花費數週餵養牠們的後代，直到幼鳥能夠自行飛行。"},{"sentence":"In some species of fish, the male parents take a more active role in protecting their <target>offspring</target> than the females do.","translation":"在某些魚類物種中，雄性親代在保護後代方面扮演的角色比雌性更積極。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"descendant","pos":"noun","translation":"後代；子孫","explanation":"強調血緣上的延續，常用於歷史或家族譜系"},{"word":"progeny","pos":"noun","translation":"後代；子嗣","explanation":"較正式的生物學術語"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"ancestor","pos":"noun","translation":"祖先","explanation":"血緣上的前輩"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"off (離開) + spring (跳出/彈出)","related":[{"word":"spring","pos":"noun","translation":"彈簧；泉水；春天","explanation":"在此指從父母身上「彈出」或脫離而來的生命。"},{"word":"offspring","pos":"adjective","translation":"後代的","explanation":"雖少見，但有時在專門文獻中用作修飾語。"}]}}

{"headword":"oppression","explanation":"「oppression」在學測中常出現在探討人權、歷史衝突或社會正義的閱讀測驗中。它不僅指物理上的壓制，更強調一種長期的、系統性的不公正待遇。理解這個字時，應將其與同根動詞 oppress 連結，並注意其常搭配的形容詞（如 systemic, brutal）。","senses":[{"sense":"壓迫；壓制","explanation":"指權力者利用權威或法律，對弱勢群體進行不公正、殘酷的統治或限制。","entries":[{"pattern":"oppression of sb.","pos":"noun","translation":"對某人的壓迫","explanation":"指針對特定群體（如少數民族、底層階級）的系統性打壓。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The brave activists spent their entire lives fighting against the systemic <target>oppression</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the minority groups in their country.","translation":"勇敢的活動家們用盡一生來對抗國家中對少數群體的系統性壓迫。"},{"sentence":"Many historical novels describe the brutal <target>oppression</target> <pattern>of</pattern> poor farmers by the greedy landlords during the feudal era.","translation":"許多歷史小說描述了封建時代貪婪的地主對貧苦農民的殘酷壓迫。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"escape from oppression","pos":"noun","translation":"逃離壓迫","explanation":"常用於描述難民或政治受難者尋求自由的情境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Thousands of refugees crossed the dangerous border in the middle of the night to escape from political <target>oppression</target> in their homeland.","translation":"數以千計的難民在深夜跨越危險的邊境，以逃離故鄉的政治壓迫。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"tyranny","pos":"noun","translation":"暴政；專制","explanation":"強調由獨裁者掌控的殘酷統治"},{"word":"persecution","pos":"noun","translation":"迫害","explanation":"強調因種族、宗教或政治信仰而受到的虐待"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"liberation","pos":"noun","translation":"解放","explanation":"指從壓迫或束縛中獲得自由"},{"word":"freedom","pos":"noun","translation":"自由","explanation":"不受限制的狀態"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 oppress (壓制) + 名詞字尾 -ion","related":[{"word":"oppress","pos":"verb","translation":"壓迫；使沮喪","explanation":"核心動詞，指利用權力對人進行打壓。"},{"word":"oppressive","pos":"adjective","translation":"壓迫的；（天氣）悶熱的","explanation":"可用於描述統治方式，或形容讓人喘不過氣的悶熱天氣。"},{"word":"oppressor","pos":"noun","translation":"壓迫者","explanation":"指執行壓迫行為的人或政權。"}]}}

{"headword":"orphanage","explanation":"「orphanage」是一個可數名詞，指提供給失去父母的孩子們居住與照顧的機構。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在關於社會福利、人道救援或個人成長故事的文本中。","senses":[{"sense":"孤兒院","explanation":null,"entries":[{"pattern":"orphanage","pos":"noun","translation":"孤兒院","explanation":"指提供食宿與照顧給失去父母之兒童的福利機構。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The kind woman spent her weekends volunteering at a local <target>orphanage</target>, reading stories to children who had lost their parents.","translation":"這位善良的女士在週末花時間在當地的孤兒院擔任志工，為那些失去父母的孩子們讀故事。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 orphan (孤兒) + 字尾 -age (表示地點或狀態的集合名詞)","related":[{"word":"orphan","pos":"noun","translation":"孤兒","explanation":"失去父母的孩子。"},{"word":"orphan","pos":"verb","translation":"使成為孤兒","explanation":"通常用於描述戰爭或自然災害導致的大量兒童失去父母。"}]}}

{"headword":"outbreak","explanation":"「outbreak」主要用於描述疾病、戰爭或暴力事件的「突然爆發」。在學測閱讀中，最常出現於健康、流行病學或國際衝突的報導，強調事件發生的突然性與不可預測性。","senses":[{"sense":"突然爆發","explanation":"指某種不愉快或危險的情況（如疾病、戰爭、暴力衝突）突然開始且迅速擴散。","entries":[{"pattern":"outbreak of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的爆發","explanation":"最常見的搭配方式，後接疾病（如 influenza, cholera）或衝突（如 war, violence, fighting）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Health officials are working hard to stop the <target>outbreak</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the mysterious virus before it spreads to other cities.","translation":"衛生官員正努力在這種神秘病毒擴散到其他城市之前，阻止這次病毒的爆發。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <target>outbreak</target> <pattern>of</pattern> war between the two neighboring countries caused thousands of innocent civilians to flee their homes.","translation":"兩國之間突然爆發的戰爭導致數千名無辜平民逃離家園。"},{"sentence":"The local government issued a strict warning after a sudden <target>outbreak</target> <pattern>of</pattern> food poisoning occurred at the school cafeteria.","translation":"在學校食堂突然爆發食物中毒事件後，當地政府發布了嚴厲的警告。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"eruption","pos":"noun","translation":"爆發","explanation":"常用於火山爆發或強烈情感的突然釋放"},{"word":"flare-up","pos":"noun","translation":"突然爆發","explanation":"常用於疾病復發或小規模衝突的突然加劇"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 out- (向外) 與 break (打破/爆發)","related":[{"word":"breakout","pos":"noun","translation":"逃脫；（皮膚）爆發","explanation":"指從監獄等封閉空間逃脫，或痤瘡突然在皮膚上出現。"},{"word":"breakthrough","pos":"noun","translation":"突破","explanation":"指在科學或談判中取得重大進展。"}]}}

<target>outgoing</target> and loves meeting new people at every school party.","translation":"雖然她的姐姐很安靜且害羞，但莎拉非常外向，喜歡在每一次的學校派對上結識新朋友。"},{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged the students to be more {"headword":"outset","explanation":"「outset」在學測中通常出現在敘述事件發展、計畫啟動或歷史演變的文章中。它最核心的用法是組成固定片語 「at the outset」，用來強調事情在「剛開始」的那個時間點，與 「at the end」 形成對比。","senses":[{"sense":"開始；開端","explanation":"指某項活動、計畫或過程的起始階段。","entries":[{"pattern":"at the outset","pos":"noun","translation":"在開始時；一開始","explanation":"這是一個極高頻的固定搭配，通常放在句首或句末，用來設定故事或事件的時間背景。注意它與 in the beginning 的區別在於 outset 更多指一個具體計畫或過程的啟動點。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although the project seemed easy <pattern>at</pattern> the <target>outset</target>, the team soon discovered that the research was far more complex than they expected.","translation":"雖然這個計畫在開始時看起來很簡單，但團隊很快發現這項研究比他們預期的要複雜得多。"},{"sentence":"The teacher made it clear <pattern>at</pattern> the <target>outset</target> that students must submit their homework before Friday if they want to receive full credit.","translation":"老師在一開始就明確表示，如果學生想要拿到全分，必須在週五之前提交作業。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"beginning","pos":"noun","translation":"開始；開端","explanation":"最通用的詞彙，指任何事情的起點"},{"word":"start","pos":"noun","translation":"開始；起點","explanation":"指行動啟動的瞬間或起點"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"conclusion","pos":"noun","translation":"結論；結束","explanation":"指過程的最後階段"},{"word":"end","pos":"noun","translation":"結束","explanation":null}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"out- (向外) + set (放置/設定)","related":[{"word":"onset","pos":"noun","translation":"（疾病、寒冬等不快之事的）開始","explanation":"通常指不愉快或不理想的事物之開端，如 the onset of winter 或 the onset of disease。"}]}}

{"headword":"outskirts","explanation":"「outskirts」一詞在學測中常用於描述居住環境、都市計畫或交通問題。最關鍵的語法特徵是：它永遠以複數形式 (outskirts) 出現，且通常搭配定冠詞 the 以及介系詞 on。","senses":[{"sense":"郊區；市郊","explanation":"指城市或城鎮最外圍的邊緣地帶，通常位於市中心與鄉村之間。","entries":[{"pattern":"on the outskirts of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"在…的郊區／市郊","explanation":"這是最標準的搭配方式。outskirts 必須使用複數型態，且介系詞固定使用 on，用以描述居住地或設施的位置。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To avoid the noisy crowds and heavy traffic of the downtown area, many young families choose to build their homes <pattern>on the outskirts of</pattern> the <target>outskirts</target> city.","translation":"為了避開市中心嘈雜的人群與沉重的交通，許多年輕家庭選擇在城市的郊區蓋房子。"},{"sentence":"The new logistics center was strategically built <pattern>on the outskirts of</pattern> the <target>outskirts</target> town to allow large trucks to enter and leave easily.","translation":"新的物流中心被策略性地建立在城鎮的郊區，以便讓大型貨車能輕鬆進出。"},{"sentence":"Many people prefer living <pattern>on the outskirts of</pattern> the <target>outskirts</target> capital because the air is fresher and the rent is much cheaper than in the city center.","translation":"許多人偏好住在首都的郊區，因為那裡的空氣更清新，且租金比市中心便宜得多。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"suburbs","pos":"noun","translation":"郊區","explanation":"指城市周邊的住宅區，通常指較舒適的居住環境"},{"word":"periphery","pos":"noun","translation":"邊緣；外圍","explanation":"較正式的字眼，指任何事物的最外圈或邊緣"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"city center","pos":"noun","translation":"市中心","explanation":null},{"word":"downtown","pos":"noun","translation":"市中心；商業區","explanation":null}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 outer (外部的) 的變體 outskirts，指最外緣的部分。","related":[{"word":"outer","pos":"adjective","translation":"外部的；外層的","explanation":"指位置在最外面的一層或部分。"},{"word":"outward","pos":"adjective","translation":"向外的；外表的","explanation":"指朝向外部的方向或僅指表面外觀。"}]}}
