{"headword":"sanitation","explanation":"「sanitation」在學測中常出現在環境保護、公共衛生與城市發展等主題。它不單指「清潔」，而是指一套完整的「公共衛生設施系統」（如排水、廢物處理），學生應將其與個人衛生 (hygiene) 區分開來。","senses":[{"sense":"公共衛生設施；衛生系統","explanation":"指公共區域的廢棄物處理、排水系統以及供水設施，以防止疾病傳播。","entries":[{"pattern":"sanitation system","pos":"noun","translation":"衛生系統；排水設施","explanation":"指城市或社區所採用的廢物處理與排水工程，是環境議題中的高頻詞組。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many poor cities in developing countries lack a proper <pattern>sanitation</pattern> <target>system</target>, leading to the rapid spread of dangerous diseases.","translation":"許多開發中國家的貧困城市缺乏完善的衛生系統，導致危險疾病迅速傳播。"},{"sentence":"The government invested millions of dollars to improve the local <target>sanitation</target> <pattern>system</pattern> to protect the river from pollution.","translation":"政府投資了數百萬美元來改善當地的衛生系統，以保護河流免於污染。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"improve sanitation","pos":"noun","translation":"改善衛生條件","explanation":"常用於描述透過建設基礎設施來提升公共健康水平。","sentences":[{"sentence":"By building more clean toilets and safe water pipes, the international organization hopes to <target>improve</target> <pattern>sanitation</pattern> in remote villages.","translation":"透過建造更多乾淨的廁所和安全的自來水管，該國際組織希望改善偏遠村莊的衛生條件。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hygiene","pos":"noun","translation":"個人衛生","explanation":"強調個人身體的清潔與健康習慣"},{"word":"drainage","pos":"noun","translation":"排水系統","explanation":"指水分排放的具體工程設施"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 sanit- (健康) + 名詞字尾 -ation","related":[{"word":"sanitize","pos":"verb","translation":"使衛生；消毒","explanation":"指透過化學藥劑或方式清除細菌，使環境變得乾淨。"},{"word":"sanitary","pos":"adjective","translation":"衛生的；乾淨的","explanation":"指符合衛生標準的，例如 sanitary napkins (衛生棉)。"}]}}

{"headword":"scrutiny","explanation":"「scrutiny」在學測中常出現在探討科學研究、政府監督、法律審查或社會輿論的文本中。其核心概念是「極其仔細的檢查」，不同於一般的 check 或 look，它強調一種帶著批判性、尋找錯誤或漏洞的深度審核。","senses":[{"sense":"詳細檢查；審查","explanation":"對某人、某事或某項文件進行極其細緻且嚴格的觀察或分析。","entries":[{"pattern":"under scrutiny","pos":"noun","translation":"受到審查；受到監督","explanation":"這是最常見的搭配用法，用來描述某人的行為或某項政策正被大眾、媒體或權威機構嚴格監督中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the company sells medicine to children, its safety standards are constantly <pattern>under</pattern> <target>scrutiny</target> by health officials.","translation":"因為該公司向兒童銷售藥品，其安全標準不斷受到衛生官員的嚴格審查。"},{"sentence":"The politician's private life came <pattern>under</pattern> <target>scrutiny</target> after he claimed that he had always lived a simple and honest life.","translation":"在那名政治家聲稱自己一直過著簡單且誠實的生活後，他的私生活開始受到審查。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"close scrutiny","pos":"noun","translation":"仔細檢查；密切審查","explanation":"用 close 修飾 scrutiny，強調檢查的程度極其精細，通常用於科學數據、法律合約或藝術品鑑定。","sentences":[{"sentence":"On <pattern>close</pattern> <target>scrutiny</target>, the expert discovered that the famous painting was actually a clever fake made ten years ago.","translation":"經過仔細檢查後，專家發現這幅名畫實際上是十年前製作的一件巧妙的偽作。"},{"sentence":"The scientists put the new data under <pattern>close</pattern> <target>scrutiny</target> to ensure there were no mistakes in their final report.","translation":"科學家們對新數據進行了密切審查，以確保他們的最終報告中沒有任何錯誤。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"inspection","pos":"noun","translation":"檢查；視察","explanation":"較泛指的檢查，可用於檢查設備或建築物"},{"word":"examination","pos":"noun","translation":"檢驗；審查","explanation":"詳細地研究或檢查某物"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"neglect","pos":"noun","translation":"忽略；疏忽","explanation":"完全不給予關注或檢查"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自拉丁語 scrutinari (仔細檢查)，與 screen (篩選) 有遠親關係。","related":[{"word":"scrutinize","pos":"verb","translation":"詳細檢查；細察","explanation":"scrutiny 的動詞形式，指執行詳細檢查的動作。"}]}}

{"headword":"stationary","explanation":"「stationary」最常考的陷阱是與其同音異義字「stationery (文具)」的混淆。在學測閱讀中，它主要用來描述物體處於靜止狀態，或在科學實驗、交通描述中表示「不動的」。","senses":[{"sense":"靜止的；不動的","explanation":"指物體沒有移動或改變位置，處於完全停止的狀態。","entries":[{"pattern":"stationary","pos":"adjective","translation":"靜止的","explanation":"描述物體在空間中不移動，常用於物理描述或交通情境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The car remained <target>stationary</target> for several minutes after the accident, as the driver was too shocked to move the steering wheel.","translation":"事故發生後，車輛在原地靜止了幾分鐘，因為駕駛員太過震驚而無法轉動方向盤。"},{"sentence":"In the science experiment, the students had to keep the camera <target>stationary</target> on a tripod to get a clear photo of the slow-moving snail.","translation":"在科學實驗中，學生必須將相機固定在三腳架上保持靜止，以便拍到那隻緩慢移動的蝸牛的清晰照片。"},{"sentence":"Despite the strong wind blowing through the valley, the heavy iron gate remained <target>stationary</target> and refused to open.","translation":"儘管山谷中強風吹襲，那扇沉重的鐵門依然保持靜止，拒絕被開啟。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"still","pos":"adjective","translation":"靜止的；不動的","explanation":"最普遍的同義詞，強調沒有動作"},{"word":"immobile","pos":"adjective","translation":"無法移動的","explanation":"強調因為某種原因而不能移動"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"moving","pos":"adjective","translation":"移動中的","explanation":null},{"word":"mobile","pos":"adjective","translation":"可移動的","explanation":null}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 stat (站立、停止) + 形容詞字尾 -ion + -ary","related":[{"word":"station","pos":"noun","translation":"車站；位置","explanation":"原本指一個固定站立的位置。"},{"word":"stationary","pos":"adjective","translation":"文具的","explanation":"注意此處為 stationery (e 結尾)，屬同音異義字。"},{"word":"stability","pos":"noun","translation":"穩定性","explanation":"由 stat (站立) 延伸而來的名詞，指狀態不變。"}]}}

{"headword":"Fahrenheit","explanation":"「Fahrenheit」是一個專有名詞，主要用於描述溫度量表。在學測閱讀中，通常出現在探討氣候、科學實驗或美國文化相關的文章中。由於其為專有名詞，首字母必須大寫。","senses":[{"sense":"華氏溫標","explanation":"一種溫度衡量單位，主要在美國使用。其冰點為 32 度，沸點為 212 度。","entries":[{"pattern":"Fahrenheit","pos":"noun","translation":"華氏（度）","explanation":"作為溫度單位的名詞。通常在數字後方直接使用，用以區分於攝氏溫標 (Celsius)。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While most countries use the Celsius scale, the United States still measures the daily temperature in <target>Fahrenheit</target>.","translation":"雖然大多數國家使用攝氏溫標，但美國仍然使用華氏溫標來衡量每日溫度。"},{"sentence":"The weather forecast warned that the heatwave would push the outdoor temperature above one hundred <target>Fahrenheit</target> tomorrow.","translation":"天氣預報警告說，明天的熱浪將使戶外溫度升至華氏 100 度以上。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"fragrance","explanation":"「fragrance」在學測中常用於描述自然景觀、化妝品工業或感官體驗。它比一般的 smell 更具正面色彩，專指「芳香」或「香氣」，常用於文學性的描述或商業產品（如香水）的討論中。","senses":[{"sense":"芳香；香氣","explanation":"指令人愉悅的氣味，通常與花卉、水果或高級香水相關。","entries":[{"pattern":"the fragrance of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的香氣","explanation":"最常見的用法，後接產生香氣的來源，如 flowers, coffee 或 perfume。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As soon as she stepped into the garden, the sweet <target>fragrance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> blooming jasmine filled the cool morning air.","translation":"她一踏進花園，盛開茉莉花的甜美香氣便充滿了清晨涼爽的空氣中。"},{"sentence":"The rich <target>fragrance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> freshly roasted coffee beans always makes the small cafe feel warm and welcoming.","translation":"新鮮烘焙咖啡豆的濃郁香氣總是讓這間小咖啡館感覺溫暖且令人心曠神怡。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"a pleasant fragrance","pos":"noun","translation":"一種宜人的香氣","explanation":"用形容詞修飾 fragrance，強調氣味的舒適感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The luxury soap was famous for leaving a <pattern>pleasant</pattern> <target>fragrance</target> on the skin that lasted for several hours.","translation":"這款奢華肥皂以在皮膚上留下能持續數小時的宜人香氣而聞名。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"scent","pos":"noun","translation":"氣味；香味","explanation":"較中性的詞，可指自然的香味或動物留下的氣味"},{"word":"aroma","pos":"noun","translation":"香味；芳香","explanation":"常用於食物、飲料或植物的濃郁香味"},{"word":"perfume","pos":"noun","translation":"香水；香氣","explanation":"通常指人工製造的香料或香水"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"stench","pos":"noun","translation":"惡臭","explanation":"極其強烈且令人不快且令人作嘔的氣味"},{"word":"odor","pos":"noun","translation":"氣味","explanation":"中性或略帶負面，指一般的氣味"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 fragr (氣味) + 名詞字尾 -ance","related":[{"word":"fragrant","pos":"adjective","translation":"芳香的；香的","explanation":"fragrance 的形容詞形式，直接描述物品具有香味。"}]}}

{"headword":"gospel","explanation":"「gospel」一詞源於古英語，原指基督教的「福音書」。在學測閱讀中，除其宗教原意外，更常出現於比喻用法，指代「被視為絕對真理、不容質疑的教條或準則」。","senses":[{"sense":"福音；福音書","explanation":"基督教中記載耶穌基督生平與教導的經文。","entries":[{"pattern":"the gospel","pos":"noun","translation":"福音；福音書","explanation":"通常指新約聖經中的四本福音書，或指基督教的核心教義。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The priest read a passage from the <target>gospel</target> to the congregation, reminding them of the importance of love and forgiveness.","translation":"牧師向會眾朗讀了一段福音書的經文，提醒他們愛與寬恕的重要性。"},{"sentence":"In many traditional churches, the choir sings beautiful songs based on the <target>gospel</target> stories of peace and hope.","translation":"在許多傳統教堂中，合唱團會演唱基於福音故事中關於和平與希望的優美歌曲。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"絕對真理；不容質疑的準則","explanation":"比喻用法，指某人的話或某種理論被視為絕對正確且必須被盲目接受。","entries":[{"pattern":"take sth. as gospel","pos":"noun","translation":"將某事視為絕對真理","explanation":"這是一個極高頻的比喻用法。當某人 take something as gospel 時，表示他們完全相信該資訊而沒有任何懷疑或質疑。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Although the internet provides a lot of information, you should not take every online article as <target>gospel</target> without checking the facts.","translation":"雖然網路提供了大量資訊，但你不應該在未核對事實之前，就將每一篇網路文章視為絕對真理。"},{"sentence":"The young athlete followed his coach's training plan as if it were <target>gospel</target>, believing it was the only way to win.","translation":"這位年輕運動員將教練的訓練計畫視為不容質疑的準則，相信這是贏得勝利的唯一方法。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"truth","pos":"noun","translation":"真理","explanation":"泛指正確的事實"},{"word":"dogma","pos":"noun","translation":"教條","explanation":"強調被強制接受且不容質疑的信念"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"古英語 gōd-spell (gōd '好' + spell '故事/訊息')，字面意為『好消息』。","related":[{"word":"evangelize","pos":"verb","translation":"傳福音；宣揚","explanation":"由希臘語 euangelion (好消息) 衍生而來，指將信仰傳播給他人。"},{"word":"evangelist","pos":"noun","translation":"傳道者；福音傳道師","explanation":"指致力於宣揚特定信仰或理念的人。"}]}}

{"headword":"harmonica","explanation":"「harmonica」是指一種小型、便攜的簧片樂器（口琴）。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在描述個人嗜好、音樂才藝或鄉村生活場景的敘事文段中。","senses":[{"sense":"口琴","explanation":null,"entries":[{"pattern":"harmonica","pos":"noun","translation":"口琴","explanation":"一種透過吹氣與吸氣產生聲音的小型管樂器。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old man sat on his porch every evening and played a soft, lonely tune on his <target>harmonica</target> as the sun set.","translation":"那位老人每天傍晚都坐在門廊上，在夕陽西下時用他的口琴吹奏出一首輕柔且孤寂的曲調。"},{"sentence":"Because it is small and easy to carry, the <target>harmonica</target> is a perfect instrument for travelers who love to make music on the road.","translation":"因為它體積小且易於攜帶，口琴對於那些喜歡在旅途中製作音樂的旅行者來說是完美的樂器。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"hijack","explanation":"「hijack」在學測中常出現在新聞閱讀或社會議題文章中。它最初是指「劫持飛機」，但現在已擴展到劫持車輛、搶奪控制權（如社交媒體帳號或對話主導權）等更廣泛的語境。","senses":[{"sense":"劫持；搶奪控制權","explanation":"強行奪取交通工具或系統的控制權，或在對話中強行將話題轉移到自己身上。","entries":[{"pattern":"hijack sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"劫持某物","explanation":"及物動詞，受詞通常是飛機、汽車或電子帳號。在現代語境中，也常用於指搶奪某個議題或對話的主導權。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The terrorists attempted to <target>hijack</target> the passenger plane, but the brave pilots managed to land the aircraft safely.","translation":"恐怖分子企圖劫持這架客機，但勇敢的機師們成功地將飛機安全降落。"},{"sentence":"Many people are worried that hackers might <target>hijack</target> their social media accounts to steal personal information and money.","translation":"許多人擔心駭客可能會劫持他們的社交媒體帳號，以竊取個人資訊和金錢。"},{"sentence":"During the team meeting, the manager was upset because one employee tried to <target>hijack</target> the entire discussion about the budget.","translation":"在團隊會議中，經理很生氣，因為一名員工試圖強行主導（劫持）關於預算的整個討論。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"hijack","pos":"noun","translation":"劫持事件","explanation":"指一次強行奪取控制權的非法行為。通常作為名詞使用時，指涉具體的事件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government spent several days negotiating with the criminals to resolve the <target>hijack</target> of the cargo ship in the ocean.","translation":"政府花了數日與犯罪分子協商，以解決在海上的那起貨船劫持事件。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"seize","pos":"verb","translation":"奪取；抓住","explanation":"強調強行拿走或控制某物"},{"word":"kidnap","pos":"verb","translation":"綁架","explanation":"特別指強行帶走人"},{"word":"capture","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉；佔領","explanation":"指透過力量或技巧將對象控制住"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"hijacked","past_participle":"hijacked"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"hijacker","pos":"noun","translation":"劫持者","explanation":"由動詞 hijack 加上執行者字尾 -er 構成。"}]}}

{"headword":"iceberg","explanation":"「iceberg」在學測中常出現於環境議題（如全球暖化、海平面上升）的科普文章，或作為隱喻（metaphor）來描述「冰山一角」現象，指表面看到的僅是事情的一小部分，而真正關鍵的問題隱藏在深處。","senses":[{"sense":"冰山","explanation":"指從冰川或冰蓋脫落並漂浮在海中的巨大冰塊。","entries":[{"pattern":"iceberg","pos":"noun","translation":"冰山","explanation":"指漂浮在海洋中巨大的冰塊，通常與氣候變遷、北極或南極研究相關。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As global temperatures continue to rise, scientists observe that many massive <target>icebergs</target> are melting faster than they used to.","translation":"隨著全球氣溫持續升高，科學家觀察到許多巨大的冰山融化速度比以往更快。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"隱喻：冰山一角","explanation":"指某個問題、現象或情況中，被察覺到的部分僅佔極小比例。","entries":[{"pattern":"the tip of the iceberg","pos":"noun","translation":"冰山一角","explanation":"極高頻的慣用語。用來比喻表面上顯現的困難或問題僅是整體中極小的一部分，暗示深處仍有更多問題。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small leak in the old pipe was just <pattern>the tip of</pattern> <target>the iceberg</target>, as the whole building's plumbing system was actually broken.","translation":"舊水管的小漏水只是冰山一角，因為整棟建築的管線系統實際上都損壞了。"},{"sentence":"The student's low grade on the final exam was <pattern>the tip of</pattern> <target>the iceberg</target>, revealing a much deeper problem with his study habits.","translation":"這名學生期末考的低分只是冰山一角，揭示出他學習習慣中一個更深層的問題。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"superficial","pos":"adjective","translation":"表面的","explanation":"指僅觸及表面，未深入核心"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"ice (冰) + berg (德語中意為山)","related":[{"word":"glacial","pos":"adjective","translation":"冰河的；極緩慢的","explanation":"由字根 glaci- (冰) 衍生而來。"},{"word":"glacier","pos":"noun","translation":"冰河","explanation":"指在陸地上緩慢移動的巨大冰塊。"}]}}

{"headword":"antonym","explanation":"「antonym」在學測中主要出現在英文學習、語言學或閱讀測驗中關於詞彙對比的段落。它是一個專業術語，指兩個詞義相反的單字。學生應將其與「synonym」（同義詞）成對記憶，以強化對詞彙系統的的理解。","senses":[{"sense":"反義詞","explanation":"指在相同語境下具有相反意義的兩個單字。","entries":[{"pattern":"antonym","pos":"noun","translation":"反義詞","explanation":"指兩個意思截然相反的單字，常用於語言學習的教材中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you are not sure about the meaning of a new word, you can look for its <target>antonym</target> in the dictionary to understand the contrast.","translation":"如果你不確定一個新單字的意義，你可以在字典中尋找它的反義詞以理解其中的對比。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to write down an <target>antonym</target> for the word 'generous', and most of them quickly wrote 'selfish'.","translation":"老師要求學生寫下 'generous' 這個字的反義詞，而大多數學生很快地寫下了 'selfish'。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"synonym","pos":"noun","translation":"同義詞","explanation":"指意思相同或相似的單字"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 anti- (相反) 與字根 onym (名稱/名字)","related":[{"word":"synonym","pos":"noun","translation":"同義詞","explanation":"字首 syn- (共同) + 字根 onym (名字)，指意思相同的名稱。"},{"word":"pseudonym","pos":"noun","translation":"筆名；假名","explanation":"字首 pseudo- (偽) + 字根 onym (名字)，指偽造的名字。"}]}}

{"headword":"apprentice","explanation":"「apprentice」指的是在專業領域中，透過在經驗豐富的導師（mentor/master）身邊工作來學習技能的初學者。在閱讀測驗中，常出現在描述傳統工藝、職業訓練或歷史背景的文本中。","senses":[{"sense":"學徒；初學者","explanation":"指在實務操作中學習專業技能的人，強調學習過程發生在實際工作環境而非教室中。","entries":[{"pattern":"apprentice","pos":"noun","translation":"學徒","explanation":"指一個正在接受職業訓練的初級人員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young man moved to the city to become an <target>apprentice</target> to a famous master carpenter who could build complex furniture.","translation":"這個年輕人搬到城市成為一名著名木匠大師的學徒，而該大師能製作複雜的家具。"},{"sentence":"In the past, a young <target>apprentice</target> would spend several years cleaning the workshop before being allowed to handle expensive tools.","translation":"在過去，一名年輕的學徒會花好幾年時間清理工作室，在被允許使用昂貴工具之前。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"serve as an apprentice","pos":"noun","translation":"擔任學徒","explanation":"強調一種身分或一段學習期間的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After finishing high school, Sarah decided to <pattern>serve</pattern> <pattern>as</pattern> an <target>apprentice</target> at a local bakery to learn how to bake professional bread.","translation":"高中畢業後，莎拉決定在當地一家麵包店擔任學徒，學習如何烘焙專業麵包。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"trainee","pos":"noun","translation":"受訓者","explanation":"現代職業訓練中更通用的名稱"},{"word":"novice","pos":"noun","translation":"新手；初學者","explanation":"強調缺乏經驗，可用於任何技能領域"},{"word":"beginner","pos":"noun","translation":"初學者","explanation":"最基礎的稱呼"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"expert","pos":"noun","translation":"專家","explanation":null},{"word":"master","pos":"noun","translation":"大師；熟練者","explanation":"指在該專業領域達到頂尖水平的人"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 apprentice (學習、抓住) 來自拉丁語 apprendre","related":[{"word":"apprenticeship","pos":"noun","translation":"學徒期；學徒身分","explanation":"指學習專業技能的那段時間或制度。"}]}}

{"headword":"packet","explanation":"「packet」在學測中主要有兩種用法：一種是實體上的「小包裝」，常用於食物或商品；另一種是數位資訊傳輸中的「數據包」。在閱讀測驗中，看到 packet 應先判斷其上下文是屬於日常生活情境還是科技資訊傳輸情境。","senses":[{"sense":"小包裝；小封包","explanation":"指將少量物品裝在紙袋或塑料袋中的小容器。","entries":[{"pattern":"a packet of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"一包…","explanation":"最常見的量詞搭配，後接如 seeds, sugar, biscuits, tea 等可數或不可數名詞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After spending a long day hiking in the mountains, the tired travelers opened a <pattern>packet</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> salty biscuits to regain some energy.","translation":"在山中徒步旅行一整天後，疲憊的旅人打開了一包鹹餅乾以恢復體力。"},{"sentence":"My grandmother always keeps a small <pattern>packet</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> sugar in her bag so that she can sweeten her coffee anywhere.","translation":"我的祖母包包裡總是放著一小包糖，這樣她隨時隨地都能為她的咖啡加糖。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"package","pos":"noun","translation":"包裹；包裝","explanation":"較為泛指的包裝，大小範圍比 packet 廣泛"},{"word":"sachet","pos":"noun","translation":"小袋子；小封包","explanation":"特指像香水樣本或糖包那樣極小的封包"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"數據包","explanation":"在電腦網絡傳輸中，將大數據切分成的小單位。","entries":[{"pattern":"data packet","pos":"noun","translation":"數據包","explanation":"科技類文章中高頻出現的專有名詞，指網絡傳輸的基本單位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When you send a message online, the computer breaks the large file into many small <target>packets</target> before sending them across the internet.","translation":"當你在網路上傳送訊息時，電腦會在將檔案透過網路傳送之前，先將大檔案分解成許多個小數據包。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"package","pos":"noun","translation":"包裹","explanation":"相關的包裝概念"},{"word":"packaging","pos":"noun","translation":"包裝材料；包裝過程","explanation":"指產品的外部包裝方式"}]}}

{"headword":"paradox","explanation":"「paradox」在學測中常用於論說文或科學文章，用來描述一種「表面上矛盾但實際上可能正確」的現象。理解這個字的關鍵在於捕捉「對立面」之間的衝突感，以及最終揭示的「深層真相」。","senses":[{"sense":"矛盾的情況；悖論","explanation":"指一種表面上自相矛盾的陳述或情況，但經過分析後可能包含某種真理。","entries":[{"pattern":"a paradox","pos":"noun","translation":"一個矛盾的現象／悖論","explanation":"指一個具體的矛盾情況或邏輯悖論，常用於描述社會現象或心理狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"It is a strange <target>paradox</target> that people who spend the most time on social media often feel the most lonely.","translation":"一個奇怪的矛盾現象是，那些在社交媒體上花最多時間的人，往往感到最孤單。"},{"sentence":"The city's growth is a <target>paradox</target>; while it has more luxury hotels, many poor families still live in tiny, broken houses.","translation":"這個城市的成長是一個矛盾；雖然它擁有更多豪華酒店，但許多貧困家庭仍然住在狹小破舊的房子裡。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"the paradox of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的矛盾之處","explanation":"用來明確指出某個特定主題或現象中存在的邏輯衝突。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Researchers are studying the <target>paradox</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sleep, where some people feel more tired after sleeping for twelve hours than they do after six.","translation":"研究人員正在研究睡眠的矛盾之處，即某些人在睡眠十二小時後比睡眠六小時後感到更疲倦。"},{"sentence":"The <target>paradox</target> <pattern>of</pattern> modern medicine is that some treatments designed to save lives can also cause severe side effects.","translation":"現代醫學的矛盾之處在於，某些旨在拯救生命的治療方法也可能引起嚴重的副作用。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"contradiction","pos":"noun","translation":"矛盾；對立","explanation":"最通用的詞彙，指兩個對立的事實或陳述彼此衝突"},{"word":"anomaly","pos":"noun","translation":"反常；異常","explanation":"強調與預期或常理不符的異常現象"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"consistency","pos":"noun","translation":"一致性","explanation":"指邏輯或行為在各方面都契合且不矛盾"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 paradox (悖論) 來自希臘語 para- (相反/超越) + dox (意見/看法)","related":[{"word":"paradoxical","pos":"adjective","translation":"矛盾的；悖論的","explanation":"由名詞 paradox 加上形容詞字尾 -ical 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"stepchild","explanation":"「stepchild」是一個家族關係詞彙。在學測中，除了其字面上的家族成員定義外，更常出現在比喻意義的閱讀測驗中，用來描述某個事物被忽視、不被重視或受到不公正對待的狀態。","senses":[{"sense":"繼子女","explanation":"指透過父母再婚而獲得的子女關係。","entries":[{"pattern":"stepchild","pos":"noun","translation":"繼子女","explanation":"指透過父母再婚而獲得的子女關係。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After her father remarried a kind woman, the young girl felt happy because she finally had a loving <target>stepchild</target> relationship with her new family.","translation":"在她父親再婚娶了一位善良的女性後，這個小女孩感到很開心，因為她終於與她的新家庭建立了溫暖的繼子女關係。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"被忽視的人或物","explanation":"比喻指某個領域、專案或主題，因為不具吸引力或獲利低而未獲足夠關注、資源或重視。","entries":[{"pattern":"the stepchild of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的被忽視者／不被重視的事物","explanation":"常用於描述某個學科或研究方向在整體系統中被排擠或忽視的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In many traditional schools, arts education is often treated as the <target>stepchild</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the education system, receiving far less funding than science and math.","translation":"在許多傳統學校中，藝術教育經常被視為教育系統中的被忽視者，獲得的資金遠比科學和數學少得多。"},{"sentence":"While the city spent millions on the downtown area, the rural outskirts were treated like a <target>stepchild</target>, with roads that were broken and old.","translation":"雖然城市花了大筆資金在市中心區域，但鄉下郊區卻被像繼子女一樣被忽視，道路破舊且老舊。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"outcast","pos":"noun","translation":"被排斥者","explanation":"指被社會或群體排斥的人"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 step- (繼親的) + child (孩子)","related":[{"word":"stepfather","pos":"noun","translation":"繼父","explanation":"由 step- 加上 father 構成。"},{"word":"stepmother","pos":"noun","translation":"繼母","explanation":"由 step- 加上 mother 構成。"},{"word":"stepsibling","pos":"noun","translation":"繼兄弟姊妹","explanation":"由 step- 加上 sibling 構成。"}]}}

{"headword":"strait","explanation":"「strait」在學測中是一個容易與「straight (筆直的)」混淆的字彙。它主要出現在地理描述或比喻性的困境描述中，指狹窄的水道或艱難的處境。要注意其單數與複數形式在語意上的細微差異。","senses":[{"sense":"海峽；狹窄水道","explanation":"指連接兩大水域的狹窄水路，通常位於兩塊陸地之間。","entries":[{"pattern":"strait","pos":"noun","translation":"海峽","explanation":"地理術語，指自然形成的狹窄通道。常用於地名（如 Strait of Gibraltar）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small fishing boat struggled to navigate through the narrow <target>strait</target> because the strong currents were pushing it toward the rocks.","translation":"這艘小漁船在穿過狹窄的海峽時十分吃力，因為強大的洋流正將它推向岩石。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"channel","pos":"noun","translation":"海峽；水道","explanation":"指連接兩大水域的通道，通常比 strait 更寬廣"},{"word":"passage","pos":"noun","translation":"通道；路徑","explanation":"泛指任何狹窄的通過路徑"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"困境；窘境","explanation":"通常以複數形式 straits 出現，用以比喻陷入極其困難或經濟拮据的處境。","entries":[{"pattern":"in dire straits","pos":"noun","translation":"處於極其困難的處境","explanation":"固定片語，指面臨嚴重的財務問題或絕望的局面，dire 作為形容詞修飾 straits。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the sudden stock market crash, the small family business found itself <pattern>in</pattern> dire <target>straits</target> and had to sell their home.","translation":"在股市突然崩盤後，這家小型家族企業發現自己處於極其困難的處境，不得不變賣他們的房產。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"predicament","pos":"noun","translation":"困境；窘境","explanation":"指陷入一種難以擺脫的尷尬或困難局面"},{"word":"plight","pos":"noun","translation":"苦難；困境","explanation":"強調處境悽慘或不幸"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自古法語 estreit，意為狹窄 (narrow)。","related":[{"word":"constrict","pos":"verb","translation":"壓縮；縮小","explanation":"字根 strict/strait 均含有狹窄之意。"}]}}

{"headword":"subjective","explanation":"「subjective」的核心概念是「基於個人感受而非客觀事實」。在學測中，常與其對立面 objective (客觀的) 成對出現，是用於討論藝術評論、個人偏好、心理感受或社會爭議時的高頻形容詞。","senses":[{"sense":"主觀的","explanation":"指基於個人意見、感受、偏好或判斷，而非基於可量化、可驗證的客觀事實。","entries":[{"pattern":"subjective opinion","pos":"adjective","translation":"主觀的意見","explanation":"描述個人對某事物的看法，這種看法無法被第三方客觀地證明對錯。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Whether a particular painting is beautiful or not is a <target>subjective</target> <pattern>opinion</pattern> that depends entirely on the viewer's taste.","translation":"某幅畫作是否美麗是一個主觀的意見，完全取決於觀賞者的口味。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"subjective experience","pos":"adjective","translation":"主觀經驗","explanation":"強調個人在特定情境下感受到的心理狀態，而非外部環境的物理屬性。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Each patient described their <target>subjective</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> of pain differently, making it difficult for doctors to measure the exact level of suffering.","translation":"每位患者對疼痛的主觀經驗描述各異，使得醫生很難衡量受苦的精確程度。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"personal","pos":"adjective","translation":"個人的","explanation":"強調與個人相關，而非普遍適用"},{"word":"biased","pos":"adjective","translation":"有偏見的","explanation":"指因個人傾向而導致不公正的判斷"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"objective","pos":"adjective","translation":"客觀的","explanation":"基於事實且不受個人情感影響"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 subject (受制於/主體) + 形容詞字尾 -ive","related":[{"word":"subjectivity","pos":"noun","translation":"主觀性","explanation":"由形容詞 subjective 加上名詞字尾 -ity 延伸而來。"},{"word":"subject","pos":"noun","translation":"主題；科目","explanation":"核心基礎名詞。"},{"word":"subject","pos":"adjective","translation":"易受…影響的","explanation":"指處於某種條件或權力的控制之下。"}]}}

{"headword":"chairperson","explanation":"在現代英語中，「chairperson」是為了取代具有性別色彩的「chairman」或「chairwoman」而產生的中性詞彙。在學測閱讀中，這個字常用於描述會議、組織或委員會的領導者，學生需注意其在正式文書中作為職稱的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"主席；主持人","explanation":"指一個委員會、會議或董事會的最高領導者，負責掌控會議流程並維持秩序。","entries":[{"pattern":"chairperson of sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"…的主席","explanation":"後接組織、委員會或會議的名稱，明確指出該職位的管轄範圍。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>chairperson</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the school board decided to postpone the meeting until next Friday to allow more teachers to attend.","translation":"學校董事會的主席決定將會議推遲到下週五，以便讓更多老師能夠參加。"},{"sentence":"After ten years of hard work, Sarah was finally elected as the <target>chairperson</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the local environmental committee.","translation":"經過十年的努力，莎拉最終被選為當地環境委員會的主席。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"act as chairperson","pos":"noun","translation":"擔任主席／主持人","explanation":"強調扮演該領導角色，常用於臨時性的會議主持或組織管理。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since the regular leader was sick, the vice president had to <target>act as chairperson</target> for the student council meeting.","translation":"由於正式的領導者生病了，副校長不得不為學生會會議擔任主持人。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"chair","pos":"noun","translation":"主席","explanation":"在現代英語中，chair 經常被用作 chairperson 的簡稱，且同樣具有性別中立性。"},{"word":"president","pos":"noun","translation":"社長；主席","explanation":"指組織的最高領導者，但通常規模更大，如國家或大型公司。"},{"word":"moderator","pos":"noun","translation":"主持人","explanation":"強調在討論或辯論中維持平衡與秩序的人。"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 chair (椅子/主席位) + 加上後綴 -person (人)","related":[{"word":"chairman","pos":"noun","translation":"主席 (男性)","explanation":"傳統用法，指男性主席。"},{"word":"chairwoman","pos":"noun","translation":"主席 (女性)","explanation":"傳統用法，指女性主席。"},{"word":"chair","pos":"verb","translation":"主持","explanation":"動詞用法，指主持會議或討論。"}]}}

{"headword":"prototype","explanation":"「prototype」在學測中常出現在科技創新、工業設計或科學實驗的文章中。它強調的是「第一個版本」或「初步模型」，用來在正式量產或實施前進行測試與修正，是理解產品開發流程的核心字彙。","senses":[{"sense":"原型；雛形","explanation":"指在開發新產品或系統時，為了測試功能而製作的第一個初步模型。","entries":[{"pattern":"prototype","pos":"noun","translation":"原型；雛形","explanation":"指一個初步的實體模型或系統，用以驗證設計想法。常與 build, develop, test 等動詞搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before starting mass production, the company built a functional <target>prototype</target> to ensure the new electric car could safely handle sharp turns.","translation":"在開始大量生產之前，該公司製作了一個功能性原型，以確保這款新型電動車能安全地處理急轉彎。"},{"sentence":"The students in the engineering class designed a small <target>prototype</target> of a wind turbine to show how wind energy can be turned into electricity.","translation":"工程課的學生們設計了一個小型風力發電機雛形，用以展示風能如何被轉化為電能。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"model","pos":"noun","translation":"模型","explanation":"泛指任何比例縮小或模擬的實體"},{"word":"draft","pos":"noun","translation":"草稿；初步版本","explanation":"常用於文件或計畫的初步版本"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"final product","pos":"noun","translation":"最終產品","explanation":"指經過所有測試與修正後的成品"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 proto- (第一、原始) + type (類型、型態)","related":[{"word":"prototypical","pos":"adjective","translation":"原型的；典型的","explanation":"由 prototype 加上形容詞字尾 -ical 延伸而來。"},{"word":"prototype","pos":"verb","translation":"製作原型","explanation":"將名詞轉化為動詞，指開發產品時製作初步模型進行測試的過程。"}]}}

{"headword":"psychiatry","explanation":"「psychiatry」是一個專業領域的名詞，指精神醫學。在閱讀測驗中，它常出現在關於心理健康、大腦科學或醫療倫理的討論中。學生應將其與 psychiatry (醫學) 和 psychology (心理學) 做區分：前者側重於醫療診斷與藥物治療，後者側重於心智行為的研究。","senses":[{"sense":"精神醫學","explanation":"醫學的一個分支，專門研究、診斷及治療精神疾病。","entries":[{"pattern":"study psychiatry","pos":"noun","translation":"學習精神醫學","explanation":"指將精神醫學作為學術研究或專業訓練的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After spending four years in medical school, the student decided to specialize in <target>psychiatry</target> to help patients with severe depression.","translation":"在醫學院就讀四年後，這位學生決定專攻精神醫學，以幫助患有嚴重憂鬱症的患者。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 psych- (心靈/精神) + 字根 iatr- (治療) + 字尾 -y (名詞)","related":[{"word":"psychiatrist","pos":"noun","translation":"精神科醫生","explanation":"由 psychiatry 演變而來的指人名詞，指具備醫學資格的治療者。"},{"word":"psychology","pos":"noun","translation":"心理學","explanation":"字首 psych- (心靈) + 字根 logy (研究/學問)，研究人類行為與心智過程。"},{"word":"psychotic","pos":"adjective","translation":"精神病性的；精神錯亂的","explanation":"描述處於精神失調狀態的特徵。"}]}}

{"headword":"rubbish","explanation":"「rubbish」在學測中具有兩種截然不同的核心語意：一是具體的「垃圾」或「廢物」，常出現在環境保護或城市管理的主題中；二是抽象的「胡說八道」或「廢話」，常用於對話或論辯中以表達強烈的否定。注意此字在英式英語中比美式英語（trash, garbage）更為常見。","senses":[{"sense":"垃圾；廢物","explanation":"指被丟棄、不再需要的物理實體物件。","entries":[{"pattern":"rubbish","pos":"noun","translation":"垃圾；廢物","explanation":"指被丟棄的廢棄物，通常作為可數或不可數名詞使用。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to install more recycling bins to prevent people from throwing <target>rubbish</target> on the streets.","translation":"市議會決定安裝更多回收桶，以防止人們將垃圾丟在街道上。"},{"sentence":"After the big storm, the beach was covered in plastic <target>rubbish</target> that had been washed up from the deep ocean.","translation":"大風暴之後，海灘上佈滿了從深海沖上岸的塑料垃圾。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"garbage","pos":"noun","translation":"垃圾","explanation":"美式英語中最常用的詞彙，指廚房或家庭廢物"},{"word":"trash","pos":"noun","translation":"垃圾","explanation":"美式英語，指乾貨垃圾或廢紙"},{"word":"waste","pos":"noun","translation":"廢物；浪費","explanation":"較為正式的用語，常指工業廢料或化學廢物"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"胡說八道；廢話","explanation":"指沒有價值、不正確或毫無意義的言論。","entries":[{"pattern":"rubbish","pos":"noun","translation":"胡說八道；廢話","explanation":"常用於否定對方觀點的口語表達，語氣較強。","sentences":[{"sentence":"He claimed that he could speak ten languages fluently, but everyone knew his story was complete <target>rubbish</target>.","translation":"他聲稱自己能流利地說十種語言，但每個人都知道他的故事完全是胡說八道。"},{"sentence":"The idea that studying for only one hour a week will lead to success is absolute <target>rubbish</target>.","translation":"認為每週只讀書一小時就能成功的想法完全是廢話。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"nonsense","pos":"noun","translation":"胡說；無稽之談","explanation":"最普遍的對應詞，強調內容缺乏邏輯或意義"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"shrub","explanation":"「shrub」在學測閱讀中常出現於自然科學、環境保護或植物生態描述。它與 tree (樹) 的主要區別在於其生長形態（分枝較多且較矮），在描述景觀設計或自然棲息地時是精確的術語。","senses":[{"sense":"灌木；矮樹","explanation":"指一種較矮的木本植物，通常具有多條從地面直接生長的幹莖，而非單一的主幹。","entries":[{"pattern":"shrub","pos":"noun","translation":"灌木","explanation":"指一種矮小的木本植物，常用於描述花園景觀或自然森林的底層植被。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To create a natural fence around the house, the gardener planted a row of thick green <target>shrubs</target> along the boundary.","translation":"為了在房子周圍建立一道自然圍欄，園丁沿著邊界種了一排茂密的綠色灌木。"},{"sentence":"Many small birds find safety from larger predators by hiding deep inside the dense branches of a wild <target>shrub</target> in the forest.","translation":"許多小鳥透過躲在森林中野生灌木的茂密分枝深處，來躲避體型較大的捕食者。"},{"sentence":"In the dry desert environment, most plants are either low <target>shrubs</target> or cacti, as these forms help them save water and survive.","translation":"在乾燥的沙漠環境中，大多數植物不是低矮的灌木，就是仙人掌，因為這些形態有助於它們節水並生存。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"bush","pos":"noun","translation":"灌木；叢林","explanation":"最常用的同義詞，在大多數語境下可互換使用"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"shrubbery","pos":"noun","translation":"灌木叢；灌木區","explanation":"由 shrub 加上名詞字尾 -ery 構成，指種植灌木的區域或一整片灌木叢。"}]}}

{"headword":"tiptoe","explanation":"「tiptoe」在學測中既可作為名詞指「腳尖」，也可作為動詞指「踮著腳尖走」。動詞用法最為常見，通常用來營造一種安靜、小心翼翼或試圖不被發現的氛圍。注意其動詞形態在過去式與過去分詞中均為 tiptoed。","senses":[{"sense":"腳尖","explanation":"指腳趾最前端的部位。","entries":[{"pattern":"on one's tiptoes","pos":"noun","translation":"踮著腳尖","explanation":"常用介系詞 on 表達狀態，指身體重心在腳尖上，常用於描述想要看清前方或試圖安靜地移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The little girl stood <pattern>on</pattern> her <target>tiptoes</target> to see if the colorful birthday cake was already placed on the table.","translation":"小女孩踮著腳尖看生日蛋糕是否已經被放在桌子上了。"},{"sentence":"Standing <pattern>on</pattern> his <target>tiptoes</target>, the short man tried to reach the heavy book on the highest shelf of the library.","translation":"那個矮個子男人踮著腳尖，試圖拿到圖書館最高層書架上的那本厚書。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"踮著腳尖走；小心翼翼地走","explanation":"指為了不發出聲音而採取的一種特殊行走方式。","entries":[{"pattern":"tiptoe","pos":"verb","translation":"踮著腳尖走","explanation":"直接作為不及物動詞使用，表示小心翼翼地移動，以避免引起他人注意。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teenager <target>tiptoed</target> into the living room at midnight, hoping his parents would not hear him return home late.","translation":"這名青少年在午夜時分踮著腳尖走進客廳，希望父母不會聽到他這麼晚才回家。"},{"sentence":"The nurse <target>tiptoes</target> carefully through the hospital ward to avoid waking up the patients who are sleeping deeply.","translation":"護理師小心翼翼地踮著腳尖走過醫院病房，以免吵醒那些正沉睡中的病人。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sneak","pos":"verb","translation":"偷偷地走；潛行","explanation":"強調為了不被發現而悄悄移動"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"tiptoed","past_participle":"tiptoed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"由 tip (尖端) 與 toe (腳趾) 組合而成的複合詞。","related":[{"word":"tiptoeing","pos":"noun","translation":"踮腳走","explanation":"動詞 tiptoe 的動名詞形式，用作名詞。"}]}}
